<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * FT-001: 盒子基础功能测试
 * 
 * 测试目标：
 * 1. Box 类的边界计算
 * 2. 可见性判断
 * 3. 盒子层级关系
 * 4. 状态快照生成
 */
const { VirtualBrowser, BoxSnapshot, PageSnapshot } = require('./virtual-browser.js');

// 从前端引擎导入 Box 类（需要先适配 Node.js）
// 这里先创建一个简化版的 Box 用于测试
class Box {
    constructor(options = {}) {
        this.id = options.id || `box_${Date.now()}`;
        this.x = options.x || 0;
        this.y = options.y || 0;
        this.width = options.width || 100;
        this.height = options.height || 40;
        this.text = options.text || '';
        this.opacity = options.opacity !== undefined ? options.opacity : 1;
        this.transform = { scale: 1, rotate: 0 };
        this.children = options.children || [];
        this.data = options.data || {};
        this.parent = null;
        this.children.forEach(child => child.parent = this);
    }
    
    getAbsolutePosition() {
        let absX = this.x, absY = this.y;
        let parent = this.parent;
        while (parent) {
            absX += parent.x;
            absY += parent.y;
            parent = parent.parent;
        }
        return { x: absX, y: absY };
    }
    
    getBounds() {
        const pos = this.getAbsolutePosition();
        return {
            x: pos.x,
            y: pos.y,
            width: this.width * this.transform.scale,
            height: this.height * this.transform.scale,
            right: pos.x + this.width * this.transform.scale,
            bottom: pos.y + this.height * this.transform.scale
        };
    }
    
    containsPoint(px, py) {
        const bounds = this.getBounds();
        return px >= bounds.x && px <= bounds.right &&
               py >= bounds.y && py <= bounds.bottom;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 断言工具
// ============================================
function assert(condition, message) {
    if (!condition) {
        throw new Error(`❌ 断言失败: ${message}`);
    }
    console.log(`  ✓ ${message}`);
}

// ============================================
// 测试用例
// ============================================
function testBoxBounds() {
    console.log('\n📦 测试盒子边界计算');
    
    // 创建简单盒子
    const box = new Box({
        id: 'test-box-1',
        x: 10, y: 20,
        width: 100, height: 50,
        text: '测试盒子'
    });
    
    const bounds = box.getBounds();
    
    assert(bounds.x === 10, 'x 坐标正确');
    assert(bounds.y === 20, 'y 坐标正确');
    assert(bounds.width === 100, '宽度正确');
    assert(bounds.height === 50, '高度正确');
    assert(bounds.right === 110, '右边界正确');
    assert(bounds.bottom === 70, '底边界正确');
}

function testBoxContainsPoint() {
    console.log('\n🎯 测试点击检测');
    
    const box = new Box({
        id: 'clickable-box',
        x: 50, y: 100,
        width: 200, height: 60
    });
    
    // 内部点
    assert(box.containsPoint(100, 120) === true, '内部点被检测到');
    assert(box.containsPoint(50, 100) === true, '左上角点被检测到');
    assert(box.containsPoint(250, 160) === true, '右下角点被检测到');
    
    // 外部点
    assert(box.containsPoint(49, 120) === false, '左边界外点不被检测');
    assert(box.containsPoint(100, 99) === false, '上边界外点不被检测');
    assert(box.containsPoint(251, 120) === false, '右边界外点不被检测');
    assert(box.containsPoint(100, 161) === false, '下边界外点不被检测');
}

function testNestedBoxes() {
    console.log('\n🌲 测试嵌套盒子');
    
    const parent = new Box({
        id: 'parent',
        x: 100, y: 100,
        width: 300, height: 200
    });
    
    const child = new Box({
        id: 'child',
        x: 20, y: 30,
        width: 100, height: 50
    });
    
    parent.addChild(child);
    
    // 子盒子的绝对位置
    const childPos = child.getAbsolutePosition();
    assert(childPos.x === 120, '子盒子绝对 x 坐标 = 父 x + 子相对 x');
    assert(childPos.y === 130, '子盒子绝对 y 坐标 = 父 y + 子相对 y');
    
    // 子盒子的边界
    const childBounds = child.getBounds();
    assert(childBounds.x === 120, '子盒子边界正确');
    assert(childBounds.right === 220, '子盒子右边界正确');
}

function testVisibilityInViewport() {
    console.log('\n👁️ 测试可见性计算');
    
    const browser = new VirtualBrowser({ width: 360, height: 640 });
    
    // 完全可见的盒子
    const visibleBox = new Box({
        id: 'visible-box',
        x: 10, y: 10,
        width: 100, height: 50
    });
    
    const snapshot1 = new BoxSnapshot(visibleBox, browser.width, browser.height);
    assert(snapshot1.visibility.visible === true, '视口内盒子可见');
    assert(snapshot1.visibility.fullyVisible === true, '视口内盒子完全可见');
    
    // 部分可见的盒子
    const partialBox = new Box({
        id: 'partial-box',
        x: 300, y: 10,
        width: 100, height: 50
    });
    
    const snapshot2 = new BoxSnapshot(partialBox, browser.width, browser.height);
    assert(snapshot2.visibility.visible === true, '跨越边界的盒子可见');
    assert(snapshot2.visibility.fullyVisible === false, '跨越边界的盒子不完全可见');
    assert(Math.round(snapshot2.visibility.visibleRatio * 100) === 60, '可见比例为 60%');
    
    // 完全不可见的盒子
    const hiddenBox = new Box({
        id: 'hidden-box',
        x: 400, y: 10,
        width: 100, height: 50
    });
    
    const snapshot3 = new BoxSnapshot(hiddenBox, browser.width, browser.height);
    assert(snapshot3.visibility.visible === false, '视口外的盒子不可见');
}

function testPageSnapshot() {
    console.log('\n📸 测试页面快照');
    
    const browser = new VirtualBrowser({ width: 360, height: 640 });
    
    // 构建页面结构
    const root = new Box({ id: 'root', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 640 });
    
    const header = new Box({ id: 'header', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 48, text: 'KFM v2' });
    root.addChild(header);
    
    const fileList = new Box({ id: 'file-list', x: 0, y: 48, width: 360, height: 592 });
    root.addChild(fileList);
    
    // 添加几个文件项
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const fileItem = new Box({
            id: `file-${i}`,
            x: 0, y: 48 + i * 50,
            width: 360, height: 48,
            text: `文件 ${i + 1}.txt`,
            data: { file: { type: 'file', name: `文件 ${i + 1}.txt` } }
        });
        fileList.addChild(fileItem);
    }
    
    // 拍摄快照
    const snapshot = browser.capture(root);
    
    console.log(snapshot.toDescription());
    
    // 验证
    const visible = snapshot.getVisibleBoxes();
    assert(visible.length === 7, '7 个可见盒子 (root + header + file-list + 4 file items)');
    
    // 验证第 5 个文件项部分可见（y: 248, bottom: 296，在 640 高度内）
    const file4 = visible.find(b => b.id === 'file-4');
    assert(file4 !== undefined, '第 5 个文件项存在');
}

function testVirtualBrowserGestures() {
    console.log('\n👆 测试手势模拟');
    
    const browser = new VirtualBrowser({ width: 360, height: 640 });
    
    // 模拟点击
    const tapEvent = browser.touchStart(180, 320);
    console.log(`  触摸开始: (${tapEvent.x}, ${tapEvent.y})`);
    
    const tapEnd = browser.touchEnd(180, 320);
    assert(tapEnd.gesture === 'tap', '识别为点击手势');
    console.log(`  触摸结束: 手势类型 = ${tapEnd.gesture}`);
    
    // 模拟右滑
    browser.touchStart(10, 320);
    browser.touchMove(100, 320);
    browser.touchMove(200, 320);
    const swipeEnd = browser.touchEnd(250, 320);
    assert(swipeEnd.gesture === 'swipeRight', '识别为右滑手势');
    console.log(`  右滑结束: 手势类型 = ${swipeEnd.gesture}, 距离 = ${swipeEnd.deltaX}px`);
    
    // 模拟左滑
    browser.touchStart(300, 320);
    browser.touchMove(200, 320);
    const swipeLeftEnd = browser.touchEnd(100, 320);
    assert(swipeLeftEnd.gesture === 'swipeLeft', '识别为左滑手势');
    console.log(`  左滑结束: 手势类型 = ${swipeLeftEnd.gesture}`);
}

function testFrameComparison() {
    console.log('\n🔄 测试帧比较');
    
    const browser = new VirtualBrowser({ width: 360, height: 640 });
    
    // 帧 1: 初始状态
    const root1 = new Box({ id: 'root', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 640 });
    root1.addChild(new Box({ id: 'box-a', x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 }));
    browser.capture(root1);
    
    // 帧 2: 移动盒子
    const root2 = new Box({ id: 'root', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 640 });
    root2.addChild(new Box({ id: 'box-a', x: 50, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 })); // 移动了
    root2.addChild(new Box({ id: 'box-b', x: 0, y: 60, width: 100, height: 50 })); // 新增
    browser.capture(root2);
    
    // 帧 3: 移除盒子
    const root3 = new Box({ id: 'root', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 640 });
    root3.addChild(new Box({ id: 'box-a', x: 50, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 }));
    // box-b 被移除了
    browser.capture(root3);
    
    // 比较帧 0 和帧 1
    const diff1 = browser.compareFrames(0, 1);
    assert(diff1.changed.length === 1, '盒子移动被检测到');
    assert(diff1.added.length === 1, '新增盒子被检测到');
    console.log(`  帧 0→1: +${diff1.added.length} 新增, ~${diff1.changed.length} 移动`);
    
    // 比较帧 1 和帧 2
    const diff2 = browser.compareFrames(1, 2);
    assert(diff2.removed.length === 1, '移除盒子被检测到');
    console.log(`  帧 1→2: -${diff2.removed.length} 移除`);
    
    // 生成报告
    console.log('\n' + browser.generateReport());
}

// ============================================
// 运行测试
// ============================================
async function runTests() {
    console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════╗');
    console.log('║   KFM v2 前端测试 - 虚拟浏览器         ║');
    console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════╝');
    
    const tests = [
        testBoxBounds,
        testBoxContainsPoint,
        testNestedBoxes,
        testVisibilityInViewport,
        testPageSnapshot,
        testVirtualBrowserGestures,
        testFrameComparison
    ];
    
    let passed = 0, failed = 0;
    
    for (const test of tests) {
        try {
            test();
            passed++;
        } catch (error) {
            failed++;
            console.error(`  ❌ 测试失败: ${error.message}`);
        }
    }
    
    console.log('\n════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log(`测试结果: ${passed}/${passed + failed} 通过`);
    console.log('════════════════════════════════════════');
    
    return failed === 0;
}

// 执行
runTests().then(success => {
    process.exit(success ? 0 : 1);
});

        return px >= bounds.x && px <= bounds.right &&
               py >= bounds.y && py <= bounds.bottom;
    }
    
    addChild(child) {
        child.parent = this;
        this.children.push(child);
        return this;
    }
    
    removeChild(child) {
        const index = this.children.indexOf(child);
        if (index > -1) {
            this.children.splice(index, 1);
            child.parent = null;
        }
        return this;
    }

| 📸 页面快照 | 结构化状态描述 |
| 👆 手势模拟 | tap / swipe / drag |
| 🔄 帧比较 | 新增/移除/移动检测 |

    ],

让我实现这个增强版快照系统——




<tool name="apply_file">
<param name="path">/sdcard/工作台/项目/kfmv2/tests/frontend/precise-snapshot.js</param>
<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * 精确快照系统
 * 
 * 核心能力：
 * 1. 记录盒子完整样式
 * 2. 计算遮盖后的可见区域
 * 3. 屏幕坐标 → 盒子映射
 * 4. 支持持久化存储
 */

// ============================================
// 盒子样式快照
// ============================================
class BoxStyleSnapshot {
    constructor(box) {
        // 基础信息
        this.id = box.id;
        this.text = box.text || '';
        
        // 位置与尺寸
        this.bounds = {
            x: box.x,
            y: box.y,
            width: box.width,
            height: box.height,
            right: box.x + box.width,
            bottom: box.y + box.height
        };
        
        // 样式
        this.style = {
            backgroundColor: box.backgroundColor || '#1a1a2e',
            borderColor: box.borderColor || '#4a4a6a',
            borderWidth: box.borderWidth || 1,
            borderRadius: box.borderRadius || 8,
            opacity: box.opacity !== undefined ? box.opacity : 1,
            textColor: box.textColor || '#ffffff',
            fontSize: box.fontSize || 14
        };
        
        // 变换
        this.transform = {
            scale: box.transform?.scale || 1,
            rotate: box.transform?.rotate || 0
        };
        
        // 渲染层级（后添加的在上面）
        this.zIndex = 0;  // 由外部设置
        
        // 可见区域（初始为完整边界，后续会被裁剪）
        this.visibleRegion = this.boundsToPolygon(this.bounds);
        
        // 被哪些盒子遮盖
        this.occludedBy = [];
        
        // 最终可见比例
        this.visibleRatio = 1.0;
        
        // 是否完全被遮盖
        this.fullyOccluded = false;
    }
    
    /**
     * 边界转换为多边形（4个顶点）
     */
    boundsToPolygon(bounds) {
        return [
            { x: bounds.x, y: bounds.y },
            { x: bounds.right, y: bounds.y },
            { x: bounds.right, y: bounds.bottom },
            { x: bounds.x, y: bounds.bottom }
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * 检查点是否在盒子内
     */
    containsPoint(px, py) {
        const b = this.bounds;
        return px >= b.x && px <= b.right && py >= b.y && py <= b.bottom;
    }
    
    /**
     * 被另一个盒子遮盖
     */
    occludeBy(otherBox) {
        this.occludedBy.push(otherBox.id);
        this.visibleRegion = this.subtractPolygon(this.visibleRegion, otherBox.bounds);
        this.updateVisibleRatio();
    }
    
    /**
     * 多边形减法（简化版：矩形裁剪）
     */
    subtractPolygon(region, subtractBounds) {
        // 简化实现：如果完全被遮盖，返回空
        // 实际应用中可以用更复杂的多边形裁剪算法
        
        const r = {
            x: Math.max(region[0].x, subtractBounds.x),
            y: Math.max(region[0].y, subtractBounds.y),
            right: Math.min(region[1].x, subtractBounds.right),
            bottom: Math.min(region[2].y, subtractBounds.bottom)
        };
        
        // 如果没有交集，原样返回
        if (r.x >= r.right || r.y >= r.bottom) {
            return region;
        }
        
        // 计算遮盖面积
        const originalArea = this.bounds.width * this.bounds.height;
        const occludedArea = (r.right - r.x) * (r.bottom - r.y);
        const remainingArea = originalArea - occludedArea;
        
        if (remainingArea <= 0) {
            // 完全被遮盖
            this.fullyOccluded = true;
            return [];
        }
        
        // 返回简化后的可见区域（这里简化处理）
        // 实际应该返回多个可能的不连续区域
        return region;
    }
    
    /**
     * 更新可见比例
     */
    updateVisibleRatio() {
        if (this.fullyOccluded) {
            this.visibleRatio = 0;
            return;
        }
        
        // 简化计算：根据遮盖盒子的数量和位置估算
        const totalArea = this.bounds.width * this.bounds.height;
        let occludedArea = 0;
        
        for (const occluderId of this.occludedBy) {
            // 简化：假设每个遮盖者遮盖 10%（实际应计算交集）
            occludedArea += totalArea * 0.1;
        }
        
        this.visibleRatio = Math.max(0, 1 - occludedArea / totalArea);
    }
}

// ============================================
// 精确页面快照
// ============================================
class PrecisePageSnapshot {
    constructor(viewportWidth, viewportHeight) {
        this.timestamp = Date.now();
        this.viewport = { width: viewportWidth, height: viewportHeight };
        
        // 所有盒子快照（按 zIndex 排序）
        this.boxes = [];
        
        // 索引：ID → 盒子快照
        this.boxesById = new Map();
        
        // 空间索引（用于快速查询点所属盒子）
        this.spatialIndex = null;
    }
    
    /**
     * 添加盒子
     */
    addBox(box, zIndex = 0) {
        const snapshot = new BoxStyleSnapshot(box);
        snapshot.zIndex = zIndex;
        
        this.boxes.push(snapshot);
        this.boxesById.set(snapshot.id, snapshot);
        
        // 处理遮盖关系：后面的盒子遮盖前面的
        for (let i = 0; i < this.boxes.length - 1; i++) {
            const existing = this.boxes[i];
            if (this.boundsOverlap(existing.bounds, snapshot.bounds)) {
                existing.occludeBy(snapshot);
            }
        }
        
        return snapshot;
    }
    
    /**
     * 检查两个边界是否重叠
     */
    boundsOverlap(a, b) {
        return !(a.right < b.x || a.x > b.right || 
                 a.bottom < b.y || a.y > b.bottom);
    }
    
    /**
     * 查询屏幕某点属于哪个盒子（从上到下检查）
     */
    getBoxAtPoint(x, y) {
        // 从后往前检查（后面的在上面）
        for (let i = this.boxes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const box = this.boxes[i];
            if (box.containsPoint(x, y) && !box.fullyOccluded) {
                return box;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取所有可见盒子
     */
    getVisibleBoxes() {
        return this.boxes.filter(b => !b.fullyOccluded);
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成详细报告
     */
    toDetailedReport() {
        let report = '';
        
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n`;
        report += `精确快照 @ ${new Date(this.timestamp).toISOString()}\n`;
        report += `视口: ${this.viewport.width} × ${this.viewport.height}\n`;
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n`;
        
        // 按渲染顺序列出
        for (let i = 0; i < this.boxes.length; i++) {
            const box = this.boxes[i];
            const b = box.bounds;
            const s = box.style;
            
            report += `┌─ [${box.id}] z-index: ${box.zIndex}\n`;
            report += `│  位置: (${b.x}, ${b.y}) → (${b.right}, ${b.bottom})\n`;
            report += `│  尺寸: ${b.width} × ${b.height}\n`;
            report += `│  样式:\n`;
            report += `│    背景: ${s.backgroundColor}\n`;
            report += `│    边框: ${s.borderColor} ${s.borderWidth}px, 圆角 ${s.borderRadius}px\n`;
            report += `│    透明度: ${s.opacity}\n`;
            
            if (box.text) {
                report += `│  文字: "${box.text}" (${s.textColor}, ${s.fontSize}px)\n`;
            }
            
            if (box.fullyOccluded) {
                report += `│  ⚠️ 完全被遮盖\n`;
            } else if (box.occludedBy.length > 0) {
                report += `│  被遮盖: ${box.occludedBy.join(', ')}\n`;
                report += `│  可见比例: ${Math.round(box.visibleRatio * 100)}%\n`;
            } else {
                report += `│  ✓ 完全可见\n`;
            }
            
            report += `└────────────────────────────────────────\n\n`;
        }
        
        // 统计
        const visible = this.getVisibleBoxes();
        report += `统计:\n`;
        report += `  总盒子数: ${this.boxes.length}\n`;
        report += `  可见盒子: ${visible.length}\n`;
        report += `  被遮盖: ${this.boxes.length - visible.length}\n`;
        
        return report;
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成屏幕像素映射表（简化版）
     */
    generatePixelMap() {
        const map = {
            viewport: this.viewport,
            pixels: {}  // "x,y" -> boxId
        };
        
        // 简化：只在盒子边界点记录
        for (const box of this.boxes) {
            if (box.fullyOccluded) continue;
            
            const b = box.bounds;
            // 记录四角和中心点
            const points = [
                [b.x, b.y],
                [b.right, b.y],
                [b.right, b.bottom],
                [b.x, b.bottom],
                [Math.floor((b.x + b.right) / 2), Math.floor((b.y + b.bottom) / 2)]
            ];
            
            for (const [x, y] of points) {
                const key = `${x},${y}`;
                const existing = map.pixels[key];
                if (!existing || this.boxesById.get(existing)?.zIndex < box.zIndex) {
                    map.pixels[key] = box.id;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return map;
    }
    
    /**
     * 导出为 JSON（用于存储）
     */
    toJSON() {
        return {
            timestamp: this.timestamp,
            viewport: this.viewport,
            boxes: this.boxes.map(b => ({
                id: b.id,
                bounds: b.bounds,
                style: b.style,
                text: b.text,
                zIndex: b.zIndex,
                occludedBy: b.occludedBy,
                visibleRatio: b.visibleRatio,
                fullyOccluded: b.fullyOccluded
            }))
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 从 JSON 恢复
     */
    static fromJSON(json) {
        const snapshot = new PrecisePageSnapshot(json.viewport.width, json.viewport.height);
        snapshot.timestamp = json.timestamp;
        
        for (const boxData of json.boxes) {
            const box = new BoxStyleSnapshot({
                id: boxData.id,
                x: boxData.bounds.x,
                y: boxData.bounds.y,
                width: boxData.bounds.width,
                height: boxData.bounds.height,
                backgroundColor: boxData.style.backgroundColor,
                borderColor: boxData.style.borderColor,
                borderWidth: boxData.style.borderWidth,
                borderRadius: boxData.style.borderRadius,
                opacity: boxData.style.opacity,
                textColor: boxData.style.textColor,
                fontSize: boxData.style.fontSize,
                text: boxData.text
            });
            box.zIndex = boxData.zIndex;
            box.occludedBy = boxData.occludedBy;
            box.visibleRatio = boxData.visibleRatio;
            box.fullyOccluded = boxData.fullyOccluded;
            
            snapshot.boxes.push(box);
            snapshot.boxesById.set(box.id, box);
        }
        
        return snapshot;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 快照存储管理器（使用 SQLite）
// ============================================
class SnapshotStorage {
    constructor(dbPath = ':memory:') {
        this.dbPath = dbPath;
        this.db = null;
    }
    
    /**
     * 初始化数据库
     */
    async init() {
        // 检查是否有 sqlite3
        try {
            const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
            this.db = new sqlite3.Database(this.dbPath);
            
            // 创建表
            await this.run(`
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    session_id TEXT,
                    frame_number INTEGER,
                    timestamp INTEGER,
                    viewport TEXT,
                    data TEXT
                )
            `);
            
            await this.run(`
                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_frame 
                ON snapshots(session_id, frame_number)
            `);
            
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('SQLite not available, using in-memory storage');
            this.db = null;
            this.memoryStore = [];
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 执行 SQL
     */
    run(sql, params = []) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            if (!this.db) {
                resolve({ changes: 0 });
                return;
            }
            this.db.run(sql, params, function(err) {
                if (err) reject(err);
                else resolve({ changes: this.changes, lastID: this.lastID });
            });
        });
    }
    
    /**
     * 保存快照
     */
    async save(snapshot, sessionId, frameNumber) {
        const data = JSON.stringify(snapshot.toJSON());
        
        if (this.db) {
            await this.run(
                `INSERT INTO snapshots (session_id, frame_number, timestamp, viewport, data) 
                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
                [sessionId, frameNumber, snapshot.timestamp, 
                 JSON.stringify(snapshot.viewport), data]
            );
        } else {
            this.memoryStore.push({
                sessionId, frameNumber,
                timestamp: snapshot.timestamp,
                snapshot: data
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 加载快照
     */
    async load(sessionId, frameNumber) {
        if (this.db) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                this.db.get(
                    `SELECT data FROM snapshots WHERE session_id = ? AND frame_number = ?`,
                    [sessionId, frameNumber],
                    (err, row) => {
                        if (err) reject(err);
                        else if (row) resolve(PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(row.data)));
                        else resolve(null);
                    }
                );
            });
        } else {
            const item = this.memoryStore.find(
                s => s.sessionId === sessionId && s.frameNumber === frameNumber
            );
            return item ? PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(item.snapshot)) : null;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取会话所有快照
     */
    async getSessionSnapshots(sessionId) {
        if (this.db) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                this.db.all(
                    `SELECT frame_number, data FROM snapshots 
                     WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY frame_number`,
                    [sessionId],
                    (err, rows) => {
                        if (err) reject(err);
                        else resolve(rows.map(r => ({
                            frameNumber: r.frame_number,
                            snapshot: PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(r.data))
                        })));
                    }
                );
            });
        } else {
            return this.memoryStore
                .filter(s => s.sessionId === sessionId)
                .map((s, i) => ({
                    frameNumber: i,
                    snapshot: PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(s.snapshot))
                }));
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 比较两个快照的差异
     */
    compare(snapshot1, snapshot2) {
        const diff = {
            added: [],
            removed: [],
            styleChanged: [],
            positionChanged: [],
            visibilityChanged: []
        };
        
        const ids1 = new Set(snapshot1.boxes.map(b => b.id));
        const ids2 = new Set(snapshot2.boxes.map(b => b.id));
        
        // 新增
        for (const id of ids2) {
            if (!ids1.has(id)) {
                diff.added.push(snapshot2.boxesById.get(id));
            }
        }
        
        // 移除
        for (const id of ids1) {
            if (!ids2.has(id)) {
                diff.removed.push(snapshot1.boxesById.get(id));
            }
        }
        
        // 变化
        for (const id of ids1) {
            if (ids2.has(id)) {
                const b1 = snapshot1.boxesById.get(id);
                const b2 = snapshot2.boxesById.get(id);
                
                // 位置变化
                if (b1.bounds.x !== b2.bounds.x || b1.bounds.y !== b2.bounds.y) {
                    diff.positionChanged.push({
                        id,
                        from: { x: b1.bounds.x, y: b1.bounds.y },
                        to: { x: b2.bounds.x, y: b2.bounds.y }
                    });
                }
                
                // 样式变化
                if (JSON.stringify(b1.style) !== JSON.stringify(b2.style)) {
                    diff.styleChanged.push({
                        id,
                        from: b1.style,
                        to: b2.style
                    });
                }
                
                // 可见性变化
                if (b1.fullyOccluded !== b2.fullyOccluded || 
                    Math.abs(b1.visibleRatio - b2.visibleRatio) > 0.1) {
                    diff.visibilityChanged.push({
                        id,
                        from: { visibleRatio: b1.visibleRatio, fullyOccluded: b1.fullyOccluded },
                        to: { visibleRatio: b2.visibleRatio, fullyOccluded: b2.fullyOccluded }
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        
        return diff;
    }
    
    /**
     * 关闭数据库
     */
    close() {
        if (this.db) {
            this.db.close();
        }
    }
}

// ============================================
// 导出
// ============================================
module.exports = {
    BoxStyleSnapshot,
    PrecisePageSnapshot,
    SnapshotStorage
};

+234 |            report += `┌─ [${box.id}] z-index: ${box.zIndex}\n`;

+236 |            report += `│  尺寸: ${b.width} × ${b.height}\n`;

+251 |            } else {

+254 |

+273 |            viewport: this.viewport,
+274 |            pixels: {}  // "x,y" -> boxId
+275 |        };
+276 |        
+277 |        // 简化：只在盒子边界点记录
+278 |        for (const box of this.boxes) {
+279 |            if (box.fullyOccluded) continue;
+280 |            
+281 |            const b = box.bounds;
+282 |            // 记录四角和中心点
+283 |            const points = [
+284 |                [b.x, b.y],
+285 |                [b.right, b.y],
+286 |                [b.right, b.bottom],
+287 |                [b.x, b.bottom],
+288 |                [Math.floor((b.x + b.right) / 2), Math.floor((b.y + b.bottom) / 2)]
+289 |            ];
+290 |            
+291 |            for (const [x, y] of points) {

+295 |                    map.pixels[key] = box.id;

+303 |    /**

+306 |    toJSON() {

+326 |    static fromJSON(json) {

+328 |        snapshot.timestamp = json.timestamp;
+329 |        
+330 |        for (const boxData of json.boxes) {
+331 |            const box = new BoxStyleSnapshot({
+332 |                id: boxData.id,
+333 |                x: boxData.bounds.x,
+334 |                y: boxData.bounds.y,
+335 |                width: boxData.bounds.width,
+336 |                height: boxData.bounds.height,
+337 |                backgroundColor: boxData.style.backgroundColor,
+338 |                borderColor: boxData.style.borderColor,
+339 |                borderWidth: boxData.style.borderWidth,
+340 |                borderRadius: boxData.style.borderRadius,
+341 |                opacity: boxData.style.opacity,
+342 |                textColor: boxData.style.textColor,

+346 |            box.zIndex = boxData.zIndex;

+359 |// ============================================
+360 |// 快照存储管理器（使用 SQLite）
+361 |// ============================================
+362 |class SnapshotStorage {
+363 |    constructor(dbPath = ':memory:') {
+364 |        this.dbPath = dbPath;
+365 |        this.db = null;
+366 |    }
+367 |    
+368 |    /**
+369 |     * 初始化数据库
+370 |     */
+371 |    async init() {
+372 |        // 检查是否有 sqlite3
+373 |        try {
+374 |            const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
+375 |            this.db = new sqlite3.Database(this.dbPath);
+376 |            
+377 |            // 创建表
+378 |            await this.run(`
+379 |                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (
+380 |                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+381 |                    session_id TEXT,
+382 |                    frame_number INTEGER,
+383 |                    timestamp INTEGER,
+384 |                    viewport TEXT,
+385 |                    data TEXT
+386 |                )
+387 |            `);
+388 |            
+389 |            await this.run(`
+390 |                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_frame 
+391 |                ON snapshots(session_id, frame_number)
+392 |            `);
+393 |            
+394 |            return true;
+395 |        } catch (e) {
+396 |            console.log('SQLite not available, using in-memory storage');
+397 |            this.db = null;
+398 |            this.memoryStore = [];
+399 |            return false;
+400 |        }
+401 |    }
+402 |    
+403 |    /**
+404 |     * 执行 SQL
+405 |     */
+406 |    run(sql, params = []) {
+407 |        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+408 |            if (!this.db) {
+409 |                resolve({ changes: 0 });
+410 |                return;
+411 |            }
+412 |            this.db.run(sql, params, function(err) {
+413 |                if (err) reject(err);
+414 |                else resolve({ changes: this.changes, lastID: this.lastID });
+415 |            });
+416 |        });
+417 |    }
+418 |    
+419 |    /**
+420 |     * 保存快照
+421 |     */
+422 |    async save(snapshot, sessionId, frameNumber) {
+423 |        const data = JSON.stringify(snapshot.toJSON());
+424 |        
+425 |        if (this.db) {
+426 |            await this.run(
+427 |                `INSERT INTO snapshots (session_id, frame_number, timestamp, viewport, data) 
+428 |                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
+429 |                [sessionId, frameNumber, snapshot.timestamp, 
+430 |                 JSON.stringify(snapshot.viewport), data]
+431 |            );
+432 |        } else {
+433 |            this.memoryStore.push({
+434 |                sessionId, frameNumber,
+435 |                timestamp: snapshot.timestamp,
+436 |                snapshot: data
+437 |            });
+438 |        }
+439 |    }
+440 |    
+441 |    /**
+442 |     * 加载快照
+443 |     */
+444 |    async load(sessionId, frameNumber) {
+445 |        if (this.db) {
+446 |            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+447 |                this.db.get(
+448 |                    `SELECT data FROM snapshots WHERE session_id = ? AND frame_number = ?`,
+449 |                    [sessionId, frameNumber],
+450 |                    (err, row) => {
+451 |                        if (err) reject(err);
+452 |                        else if (row) resolve(PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(row.data)));
+453 |                        else resolve(null);
+454 |                    }
+455 |                );
+456 |            });
+457 |        } else {
+458 |            const item = this.memoryStore.find(
+459 |                s => s.sessionId === sessionId && s.frameNumber === frameNumber
+460 |            );
+461 |            return item ? PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(item.snapshot)) : null;
+462 |        }
+463 |    }
+464 |    
+465 |    /**
+466 |     * 获取会话所有快照
+467 |     */
+468 |    async getSessionSnapshots(sessionId) {
+469 |        if (this.db) {
+470 |            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+471 |                this.db.all(
+472 |                    `SELECT frame_number, data FROM snapshots 
+473 |                     WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY frame_number`,
+474 |                    [sessionId],
+475 |                    (err, rows) => {
+476 |                        if (err) reject(err);
+477 |                        else resolve(rows.map(r => ({
+478 |                            frameNumber: r.frame_number,
+479 |                            snapshot: PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(r.data))
+480 |                        })));
+481 |                    }
+482 |                );
+483 |            });
+484 |        } else {
+485 |            return this.memoryStore
+486 |                .filter(s => s.sessionId === sessionId)
+487 |                .map((s, i) => ({
+488 |                    frameNumber: i,
+489 |                    snapshot: PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(JSON.parse(s.snapshot))
+490 |                }));
+491 |        }
+492 |    }
+493 |    
+494 |    /**
+495 |     * 比较两个快照的差异

+497 |    compare(snapshot1, snapshot2) {

+502 |            positionChanged: [],
+503 |            visibilityChanged: []
+504 |        };
+505 |

+508 |

+520 |            }
+521 |        }
+522 |        
+523 |        // 变化

+527 |                const b2 = snapshot2.boxesById.get(id);
+528 |                
+529 |                // 位置变化
+530 |                if (b1.bounds.x !== b2.bounds.x || b1.bounds.y !== b2.bounds.y) {
+531 |                    diff.positionChanged.push({

<tool name="apply_file">

<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * FT-002: 精确快照测试
 * 
 * 测试目标：
 * 1. 完整样式记录
 * 2. 遮盖计算
 * 3. 屏幕坐标 → 盒子映射
 * 4. JSON 序列化与恢复
 */
const { PrecisePageSnapshot, SnapshotStorage } = require('./precise-snapshot.js');

// ============================================
// 断言工具
// ============================================
function assert(condition, message) {
    if (!condition) {
        throw new Error(`❌ 断言失败: ${message}`);
    }
    console.log(`  ✓ ${message}`);
}

// ============================================
// 测试用例
// ============================================
function testPreciseStyle() {
    console.log('\n🎨 测试完整样式记录');
    
    const snapshot = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    
    // 添加一个带完整样式的盒子
    const box = snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'styled-box',
        x: 20, y: 30,
        width: 200, height: 60,
        backgroundColor: '#2a2a4e',
        borderColor: '#4a4a8a',
        borderWidth: 2,
        borderRadius: 12,
        opacity: 0.9,
        textColor: '#e0e0e0',
        fontSize: 16,
        text: '样式盒子'
    }, 1);
    
    // 验证样式被记录
    assert(box.style.backgroundColor === '#2a2a4e', '背景色正确');
    assert(box.style.borderRadius === 12, '圆角正确');
    assert(box.style.opacity === 0.9, '透明度正确');
    assert(box.text === '样式盒子', '文字正确');
    
    // 生成详细报告
    console.log('\n' + snapshot.toDetailedReport());
}

function testOcclusion() {
    console.log('\n🔍 测试遮盖计算');
    
    const snapshot = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    
    // 添加底层盒子
    const bottom = snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'bottom-box',
        x: 50, y: 50,
        width: 200, height: 100,
        backgroundColor: '#ff0000'
    }, 0);
    
    // 添加顶层盒子（遮盖底层）
    const top = snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'top-box',
        x: 100, y: 80,
        width: 200, height: 100,
        backgroundColor: '#00ff00'
    }, 1);
    
    // 验证遮盖关系
    assert(bottom.occludedBy.includes('top-box'), '底层盒子被顶层遮盖');
    assert(top.occludedBy.length === 0, '顶层盒子没有被遮盖');
    
    console.log(`  底层盒子可见比例: ${Math.round(bottom.visibleRatio * 100)}%`);
    console.log(`  顶层盒子可见比例: ${Math.round(top.visibleRatio * 100)}%`);
}

function testPointToBox() {
    console.log('\n📍 测试屏幕坐标 → 盒子映射');
    
    const snapshot = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    
    // 添加多个盒子
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'box-a',
        x: 0, y: 0,
        width: 180, height: 320,
        backgroundColor: '#ff0000'
    }, 0);
    
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'box-b',
        x: 180, y: 0,
        width: 180, height: 320,
        backgroundColor: '#00ff00'
    }, 1);
    
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'box-c',
        x: 90, y: 160,
        width: 180, height: 320,
        backgroundColor: '#0000ff'
    }, 2);  // 这个在中间，zIndex 最高
    
    // 测试点映射
    const tests = [
        { x: 50, y: 50, expected: 'box-a' },
        { x: 250, y: 50, expected: 'box-b' },
        { x: 180, y: 300, expected: 'box-c' },  // box-c 遮盖了部分 box-a 和 box-b
        { x: 100, y: 500, expected: 'box-c' },
    ];
    
    for (const t of tests) {
        const box = snapshot.getBoxAtPoint(t.x, t.y);
        assert(box && box.id === t.expected, 
               `点 (${t.x}, ${t.y}) 属于 ${t.expected}`);
    }
}

function testJsonSerialization() {
    console.log('\n💾 测试 JSON 序列化与恢复');
    
    const original = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    
    original.addBox({
        id: 'test-box',
        x: 10, y: 20,
        width: 100, height: 50,
        backgroundColor: '#123456',
        borderColor: '#654321',
        borderRadius: 8,
        opacity: 0.8,
        text: '测试'
    }, 0);
    
    // 序列化
    const json = original.toJSON();
    console.log(`  JSON 大小: ${JSON.stringify(json).length} 字节`);
    
    // 反序列化
    const restored = PrecisePageSnapshot.fromJSON(json);
    
    // 验证
    assert(restored.viewport.width === 360, '视口宽度恢复正确');
    assert(restored.boxes.length === 1, '盒子数量正确');
    
    const box = restored.boxes[0];
    assert(box.id === 'test-box', '盒子 ID 恢复正确');
    assert(box.style.backgroundColor === '#123456', '背景色恢复正确');
    assert(box.style.borderRadius === 8, '圆角恢复正确');
}

async function testStorage() {
    console.log('\n🗄️ 测试存储系统');
    
    const storage = new SnapshotStorage(':memory:');
    await storage.init();
    
    // 创建快照
    const snap1 = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    snap1.addBox({ id: 'box-1', x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 }, 0);
    
    const snap2 = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    snap2.addBox({ id: 'box-1', x: 50, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 }, 0);  // 移动了
    snap2.addBox({ id: 'box-2', x: 0, y: 60, width: 100, height: 50 }, 1);  // 新增
    
    // 保存
    await storage.save(snap1, 'test-session', 0);
    await storage.save(snap2, 'test-session', 1);
    
    // 加载
    const loaded = await storage.load('test-session', 0);
    assert(loaded !== null, '快照加载成功');
    assert(loaded.boxes.length === 1, '加载的盒子数量正确');
    
    // 比较
    const diff = storage.compare(snap1, snap2);
    assert(diff.added.length === 1, '检测到新增盒子');
    assert(diff.positionChanged.length === 1, '检测到位置变化');
    
    console.log(`  新增: ${diff.added.map(b => b.id).join(', ')}`);
    console.log(`  移动: ${diff.positionChanged.map(c => `${c.id} (${c.from.x},${c.from.y}→${c.to.x},${c.to.y})`).join(', ')}`);
    
    storage.close();
}

function testComplexPage() {
    console.log('\n📱 测试复杂页面快照');
    
    const snapshot = new PrecisePageSnapshot(360, 640);
    
    // 模拟一个文件管理器页面
    // 顶部栏
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'header',
        x: 0, y: 0,
        width: 360, height: 48,
        backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e',
        text: 'KFM v2 - 文件管理器'
    }, 0);
    
    // 侧栏（初始隐藏在左边）
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'sidebar',
        x: -280, y: 48,
        width: 280, height: 592,
        backgroundColor: '#12121f'
    }, 1);
    
    // 主内容区
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'main',
        x: 0, y: 48,
        width: 360, height: 592,
        backgroundColor: '#0d0d1a'
    }, 2);
    
    // 文件列表
    const files = ['文档', '图片', '音乐', '视频', '下载'];
    files.forEach((name, i) => {
        snapshot.addBox({
            id: `file-${i}`,
            x: 0, y: 48 + i * 56,
            width: 360, height: 55,
            backgroundColor: i % 2 === 0 ? '#1a1a2e' : '#151528',
            borderRadius: 4,
            text: `📁 ${name}`
        }, 3 + i);
    });
    
    // 底部操作栏
    snapshot.addBox({
        id: 'bottom-bar',
        x: 0, y: 592,
        width: 360, height: 48,
        backgroundColor: '#1a1a2e'
    }, 100);
    
    // 生成报告
    console.log(snapshot.toDetailedReport());
    
    // 测试点映射
    console.log('\n点映射测试:');
    const points = [
        [180, 24],   // header 中心
        [180, 100],  // file-0 区域
        [180, 616],  // bottom-bar
    ];
    
    for (const [x, y] of points) {
        const box = snapshot.getBoxAtPoint(x, y);
        console.log(`  (${x}, ${y}) → ${box ? box.id : '无'}`);
    }
    
    // 生成像素映射
    const pixelMap = snapshot.generatePixelMap();
    console.log(`\n像素映射: ${Object.keys(pixelMap.pixels).length} 个关键点`);
}

// ============================================
// 运行测试
// ============================================
async function runTests() {
    console.log('╔════════════════════════════════════════╗');
    console.log('║   KFM v2 精确快照测试                  ║');
    console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════╝');
    
    const tests = [
        testPreciseStyle,
        testOcclusion,
        testPointToBox,
        testJsonSerialization,
        testStorage,
        testComplexPage
    ];
    
    let passed = 0, failed = 0;
    
    for (const test of tests) {
        try {
            await test();
            passed++;
        } catch (error) {
            failed++;
            console.error(`  ❌ 测试失败: ${error.message}`);
        }
    }
    
    console.log('\n════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log(`测试结果: ${passed}/${passed + failed} 通过`);
    console.log('════════════════════════════════════════');
    
    return failed === 0;
}

// 执行
runTests().then(success => {
    process.exit(success ? 0 : 1);
});

同一个盒子：

- 真机: x=100px → 屏幕上 100px，但实际物理尺寸不同！

// ============================================
// 设备模拟器
// ============================================
class DeviceSimulator {
    constructor(profileName = 'test-standard') {
        // 获取设备配置
        this.profile = DEVICE_PROFILES[profileName];
        if (!this.profile) {
            console.warn(`设备 "${profileName}" 未找到，使用标准测试设备`);
            this.profile = DEVICE_PROFILES['test-standard'];
        }
        
        // 核心参数
        this.name = this.profile.name;
        this.physical = { ...this.profile.physical };
        this.viewport = { ...this.profile.viewport };
        this.dpr = this.profile.dpr;
        this.ppi = this.profile.ppi;
        
        // 计算派生值
        this.aspectRatio = this.physical.width / this.physical.height;
        this.orientation = this.physical.width > this.physical.height ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
        
        // 安全区（考虑刘海/圆角）
        this.safeArea = this.calculateSafeArea();
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算安全区域
     */
    calculateSafeArea() {
        const { notch, borderRadius, viewport, physical } = this.profile;
        
        let safeTop = 0;
        let safeBottom = 0;
        let safeLeft = borderRadius || 0;
        let safeRight = borderRadius || 0;
        
        // 刘海处理
        if (notch === 'dynamic-island') {
            safeTop = 59;  // iOS 动态岛
        } else if (notch === 'punch-hole') {
            safeTop = 40;  // 打孔屏
        } else if (notch === 'notch') {
            safeTop = 44;  // 传统刘海
        }
        
        // 底部手势区域
        if (this.profile.type !== 'tablet') {
            safeBottom = 34;
        }
        
        return {
            top: safeTop,
            bottom: safeBottom,
            left: safeLeft,
            right: safeRight,
            // 可用视口
            availableWidth: viewport.width - safeLeft - safeRight,
            availableHeight: viewport.height - safeTop - safeBottom
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 逻辑像素 → 物理像素
     */
    logicalToPhysical(x, y) {
        return {
            x: Math.round(x * this.dpr),
            y: Math.round(y * this.dpr)
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 物理像素 → 逻辑像素
     */
    physicalToLogical(px, py) {
        return {
            x: px / this.dpr,
            y: py / this.dpr
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 检查点是否在安全区域内
     */
    isInSafeArea(x, y, width, height) {
        const sa = this.safeArea;
        return x >= sa.left && 
               x + width <= this.viewport.width - sa.right &&
               y >= sa.top &&
               y + height <= this.viewport.height - sa.bottom;
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取设备信息摘要
     */
    getInfo() {
        return {
            name: this.name,
            resolution: `${this.physical.width} × ${this.physical.height}`,
            viewport: `${this.viewport.width} × ${this.viewport.height}`,
            dpr: this.dpr,
            ppi: this.ppi,
            aspectRatio: this.aspectRatio.toFixed(2),
            safeArea: this.safeArea
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成设备配置报告
     */
    generateReport() {
        const info = this.getInfo();
        let report = '';
        
        report += `╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
        report += `║  设备模拟器: ${this.name.padEnd(30)}║\n`;
        report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
        report += `║  物理分辨率: ${info.resolution.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
        report += `║  逻辑视口:   ${info.viewport.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
        report += `║  设备像素比: ${String(this.dpr).padEnd(29)}║\n`;
        report += `║  像素密度:   ${String(this.ppi + ' PPI').padEnd(29)}║\n`;
        report += `║  屏幕比例:   ${info.aspectRatio.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
        report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
        report += `║  安全区:                                            ║\n`;
        report += `║    顶部: ${String(this.safeArea.top + 'px').padEnd(34)}║\n`;
        report += `║    底部: ${String(this.safeArea.bottom + 'px').padEnd(34)}║\n`;
        report += `║    可用区域: ${String(info.safeArea.availableWidth + ' × ' + info.safeArea.availableHeight).padEnd(28)}║\n`;
        report += `╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n`;
        
        return report;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 响应式布局测试器
// ============================================
class ResponsiveLayoutTester {
    constructor() {
        this.devices = [];
        this.currentDevice = null;
        this.snapshots = new Map();  // deviceName → snapshot
    }
    
    /**
     * 添加测试设备
     */
    addDevice(profileName) {
        const simulator = new DeviceSimulator(profileName);
        this.devices.push(simulator);
        return simulator;
    }
    
    /**
     * 设置当前设备
     */
    setCurrentDevice(profileName) {
        this.currentDevice = new DeviceSimulator(profileName);
        return this.currentDevice;
    }
    
    /**
     * 测试盒子在所有设备上的表现
     */
    testBoxAcrossDevices(boxConfig) {
        const results = [];
        
        for (const device of this.devices) {
            const viewport = device.viewport;
            const safeArea = device.safeArea;
            
            // 计算盒子在当前设备上的状态
            const box = {
                ...boxConfig,
                // 检查是否超出视口
                inViewport: boxConfig.x >= 0 && 
                           boxConfig.x + boxConfig.width <= viewport.width &&
                           boxConfig.y >= 0 &&
                           boxConfig.y + boxConfig.height <= viewport.height,
                // 检查是否在安全区
                inSafeArea: device.isInSafeArea(
                    boxConfig.x, boxConfig.y,
                    boxConfig.width, boxConfig.height
                ),
                // 计算缩放建议
                scaleSuggestion: this.calculateScale(boxConfig, device)
            };
            
            results.push({
                device: device.name,
                viewport: `${viewport.width} × ${viewport.height}`,
                dpr: device.dpr,
                ...box
            });
        }
        
        return results;
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算缩放建议
     */
    calculateScale(box, device) {
        const viewport = device.viewport;
        const boxWidth = box.width;
        const boxHeight = box.height;
        
        // 如果盒子太大，建议缩放
        if (boxWidth > viewport.width * 0.9) {
            return {
                needed: true,
                ratio: (viewport.width * 0.9) / boxWidth
            };
        }
        
        return { needed: false, ratio: 1 };
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成跨设备测试报告
     */
    generateCrossDeviceReport(boxConfig) {
        const results = this.testBoxAcrossDevices(boxConfig);
        
        let report = '';
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n`;
        report += `盒子: "${boxConfig.id}" (${boxConfig.width} × ${boxConfig.height})\n`;
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n`;
        
        for (const r of results) {
            const status = r.inViewport && r.inSafeArea ? '✅' : 
                          r.inViewport ? '⚠️' : '❌';
            
            report += `${status} ${r.device.padEnd(20)} `;
            report += `视口: ${r.viewport.padEnd(12)} `;
            report += `DPR: ${r.dpr}\n`;
            
            if (!r.inViewport) {
                report += `   ⚠️ 超出视口边界\n`;
            }
            if (!r.inSafeArea) {
                report += `   ⚠️ 可能被刘海/圆角遮挡\n`;
            }
            if (r.scaleSuggestion.needed) {
                report += `   📐 建议缩放: ${Math.round(r.scaleSuggestion.ratio * 100)}%\n`;
            }
        }
        
        return report;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 视口适配工具
// ============================================
class ViewportAdapter {
    constructor(sourceDevice, targetDevice) {
        this.source = new DeviceSimulator(sourceDevice);
        this.target = new DeviceSimulator(targetDevice);
    }
    
    /**
     * 转换盒子坐标
     */
    adaptBox(box) {
        const sourceViewport = this.source.viewport;
        const targetViewport = this.target.viewport;
        
        // 计算相对位置（百分比）
        const relativeX = box.x / sourceViewport.width;
        const relativeY = box.y / sourceViewport.height;
        const relativeWidth = box.width / sourceViewport.width;
        const relativeHeight = box.height / sourceViewport.height;
        
        // 转换到目标设备
        return {
            ...box,
            x: Math.round(relativeX * targetViewport.width),
            y: Math.round(relativeY * targetViewport.height),
            width: Math.round(relativeWidth * targetViewport.width),
            height: Math.round(relativeHeight * targetViewport.height),
            // 原始值保留
            _original: { x: box.x, y: box.y, width: box.width, height: box.height }
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 批量转换
     */
    adaptBoxes(boxes) {
        return boxes.map(box => this.adaptBox(box));
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成适配报告
     */
    generateAdaptationReport(box) {
        const adapted = this.adaptBox(box);
        
        let report = '';
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n`;
        report += `视口适配: ${this.source.name} → ${this.target.name}\n`;
        report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n`;
        
        report += `原始 (${this.source.name}):\n`;
        report += `  位置: (${box.x}, ${box.y})\n`;
        report += `  尺寸: ${box.width} × ${box.height}\n\n`;
        
        report += `适配后 (${this.target.name}):\n`;
        report += `  位置: (${adapted.x}, ${adapted.y})\n`;
        report += `  尺寸: ${adapted.width} × ${adapted.height}\n\n`;
        
        report += `变化:\n`;
        report += `  X: ${adapted.x - box.x >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.x - box.x}px\n`;
        report += `  Y: ${adapted.y - box.y >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.y - box.y}px\n`;
        report += `  宽度: ${adapted.width - box.width >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.width - box.width}px\n`;
        report += `  高度: ${adapted.height - box.height >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.height - box.height}px\n`;
        
        return report;
    }
}

// ============================================
// 导出
// ============================================
module.exports = {
    DEVICE_PROFILES,
    DeviceSimulator,
    ResponsiveLayoutTester,
    ViewportAdapter
};

131| // ============================================
132| // 设备模拟器
133| // ============================================
134| class DeviceSimulator {
135|     constructor(profileName = 'test-standard') {
136|         // 获取设备配置
137|         this.profile = DEVICE_PROFILES[profileName];
138|         if (!this.profile) {
139|             console.warn(`设备 "${profileName}" 未找到，使用标准测试设备`);
140|             this.profile = DEVICE_PROFILES['test-standard'];
141|         }
142|         
143|         // 核心参数
144|         this.name = this.profile.name;
145|         this.physical = { ...this.profile.physical };
146|         this.viewport = { ...this.profile.viewport };
147|         this.dpr = this.profile.dpr;
148|         this.ppi = this.profile.ppi;
149|         
150|         // 计算派生值
151|         this.aspectRatio = this.physical.width / this.physical.height;
152|         this.orientation = this.physical.width > this.physical.height ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
153|         
154|         // 安全区（考虑刘海/圆角）
155|         this.safeArea = this.calculateSafeArea();
156|     }
157|     
158|     /**
159|      * 计算安全区域
160|      */
161|     calculateSafeArea() {
162|         const { notch, borderRadius, viewport, physical } = this.profile;
163|         
164|         let safeTop = 0;
165|         let safeBottom = 0;
166|         let safeLeft = borderRadius || 0;
167|         let safeRight = borderRadius || 0;
168|         
169|         // 刘海处理
170|         if (notch === 'dynamic-island') {
171|             safeTop = 59;  // iOS 动态岛
172|         } else if (notch === 'punch-hole') {
173|             safeTop = 40;  // 打孔屏
174|         } else if (notch === 'notch') {
175|             safeTop = 44;  // 传统刘海
176|         }
177|         
178|         // 底部手势区域
179|         if (this.profile.type !== 'tablet') {
180|             safeBottom = 34;
181|         }
182|         
183|         return {
184|             top: safeTop,
185|             bottom: safeBottom,
186|             left: safeLeft,
187|             right: safeRight,
188|             // 可用视口
189|             availableWidth: viewport.width - safeLeft - safeRight,
190|             availableHeight: viewport.height - safeTop - safeBottom
191|         };
192|     }
193|     
194|     /**
195|      * 逻辑像素 → 物理像素
196|      */
197|     logicalToPhysical(x, y) {
198|         return {
199|             x: Math.round(x * this.dpr),
200|             y: Math.round(y * this.dpr)
201|         };
202|     }
203|     
204|     /**
205|      * 物理像素 → 逻辑像素
206|      */
207|     physicalToLogical(px, py) {
208|         return {
209|             x: px / this.dpr,
210|             y: py / this.dpr
211|         };
212|     }
213|     
214|     /**
215|      * 检查点是否在安全区域内
216|      */
217|     isInSafeArea(x, y, width, height) {
218|         const sa = this.safeArea;
219|         return x >= sa.left && 
220|                x + width <= this.viewport.width - sa.right &&
221|                y >= sa.top &&
222|                y + height <= this.viewport.height - sa.bottom;
223|     }
224|

227|      */
228|     getInfo() {

232|             viewport: `${this.viewport.width} × ${this.viewport.height}`,
233|             dpr: this.dpr,
234|             ppi: this.ppi,
235|             aspectRatio: this.aspectRatio.toFixed(2),
236|             safeArea: this.safeArea
237|         };
238|     }
239|     
240|     /**

249|         report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
250|         report += `║  物理分辨率: ${info.resolution.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
251|         report += `║  逻辑视口:   ${info.viewport.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
252|         report += `║  设备像素比: ${String(this.dpr).padEnd(29)}║\n`;
253|         report += `║  像素密度:   ${String(this.ppi + ' PPI').padEnd(29)}║\n`;
254|         report += `║  屏幕比例:   ${info.aspectRatio.padEnd(29)}║\n`;
255|         report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
256|         report += `║  安全区:                                            ║\n`;
257|         report += `║    顶部: ${String(this.safeArea.top + 'px').padEnd(34)}║\n`;
258|         report += `║    底部: ${String(this.safeArea.bottom + 'px').padEnd(34)}║\n`;
259|         report += `║    可用区域: ${String(info.safeArea.availableWidth + ' × ' + info.safeArea.availableHeight).padEnd(28)}║\n`;
260|         report += `╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n`;
261|         
262|         return report;
263|     }
264| }

266| // ============================================
267| // 响应式布局测试器
268| // ============================================
269| class ResponsiveLayoutTester {
270|     constructor() {
271|         this.devices = [];
272|         this.currentDevice = null;
273|         this.snapshots = new Map();  // deviceName → snapshot
274|     }
275|     
276|     /**
277|      * 添加测试设备
278|      */
279|     addDevice(profileName) {
280|         const simulator = new DeviceSimulator(profileName);
281|         this.devices.push(simulator);
282|         return simulator;
283|     }
284|     
285|     /**
286|      * 设置当前设备
287|      */
288|     setCurrentDevice(profileName) {
289|         this.currentDevice = new DeviceSimulator(profileName);
290|         return this.currentDevice;
291|     }
292|     
293|     /**
294|      * 测试盒子在所有设备上的表现
295|      */
296|     testBoxAcrossDevices(boxConfig) {
297|         const results = [];
298|         
299|         for (const device of this.devices) {
300|             const viewport = device.viewport;
301|             const safeArea = device.safeArea;
302|             
303|             // 计算盒子在当前设备上的状态
304|             const box = {
305|                 ...boxConfig,
306|                 // 检查是否超出视口
307|                 inViewport: boxConfig.x >= 0 && 
308|                            boxConfig.x + boxConfig.width <= viewport.width &&
309|                            boxConfig.y >= 0 &&
310|                            boxConfig.y + boxConfig.height <= viewport.height,
311|                 // 检查是否在安全区
312|                 inSafeArea: device.isInSafeArea(
313|                     boxConfig.x, boxConfig.y,
314|                     boxConfig.width, boxConfig.height
315|                 ),
316|                 // 计算缩放建议
317|                 scaleSuggestion: this.calculateScale(boxConfig, device)
318|             };
319|             
320|             results.push({
321|                 device: device.name,
322|                 viewport: `${viewport.width} × ${viewport.height}`,
323|                 dpr: device.dpr,
324|                 ...box
325|             });
326|         }
327|         
328|         return results;
329|     }
330|     
331|     /**
332|      * 计算缩放建议
333|      */
334|     calculateScale(box, device) {
335|         const viewport = device.viewport;
336|         const boxWidth = box.width;
337|         const boxHeight = box.height;
338|         
339|         // 如果盒子太大，建议缩放
340|         if (boxWidth > viewport.width * 0.9) {
341|             return {
342|                 needed: true,
343|                 ratio: (viewport.width * 0.9) / boxWidth
344|             };
345|         }
346|         
347|         return { needed: false, ratio: 1 };
348|     }
349|     
350|     /**
351|      * 生成跨设备测试报告
352|      */
353|     generateCrossDeviceReport(boxConfig) {
354|         const results = this.testBoxAcrossDevices(boxConfig);
355|         
356|         let report = '';
357|         report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n`;
358|         report += `盒子: "${boxConfig.id}" (${boxConfig.width} × ${boxConfig.height})\n`;
359|         report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n`;
360|         
361|         for (const r of results) {
362|             const status = r.inViewport && r.inSafeArea ? '✅' : 
363|                           r.inViewport ? '⚠️' : '❌';
364|             
365|             report += `${status} ${r.device.padEnd(20)} `;
366|             report += `视口: ${r.viewport.padEnd(12)} `;
367|             report += `DPR: ${r.dpr}\n`;
368|             
369|             if (!r.inViewport) {
370|                 report += `   ⚠️ 超出视口边界\n`;
371|             }
372|             if (!r.inSafeArea) {
373|                 report += `   ⚠️ 可能被刘海/圆角遮挡\n`;
374|             }
375|             if (r.scaleSuggestion.needed) {
376|                 report += `   📐 建议缩放: ${Math.round(r.scaleSuggestion.ratio * 100)}%\n`;
377|             }
378|         }
379|         
380|         return report;
381|     }
382| }

384| // ============================================
385| // 视口适配工具
386| // ============================================
387| class ViewportAdapter {
388|     constructor(sourceDevice, targetDevice) {
389|         this.source = new DeviceSimulator(sourceDevice);
390|         this.target = new DeviceSimulator(targetDevice);
391|     }
392|     
393|     /**
394|      * 转换盒子坐标
395|      */
396|     adaptBox(box) {
397|         const sourceViewport = this.source.viewport;
398|         const targetViewport = this.target.viewport;
399|         
400|         // 计算相对位置（百分比）
401|         const relativeX = box.x / sourceViewport.width;
402|         const relativeY = box.y / sourceViewport.height;
403|         const relativeWidth = box.width / sourceViewport.width;
404|         const relativeHeight = box.height / sourceViewport.height;
405|         
406|         // 转换到目标设备
407|         return {
408|             ...box,
409|             x: Math.round(relativeX * targetViewport.width),
410|             y: Math.round(relativeY * targetViewport.height),
411|             width: Math.round(relativeWidth * targetViewport.width),
412|             height: Math.round(relativeHeight * targetViewport.height),
413|             // 原始值保留
414|             _original: { x: box.x, y: box.y, width: box.width, height: box.height }
415|         };
416|     }
417|     
418|     /**
419|      * 批量转换
420|      */
421|     adaptBoxes(boxes) {
422|         return boxes.map(box => this.adaptBox(box));
423|     }
424|     
425|     /**
426|      * 生成适配报告
427|      */
428|     generateAdaptationReport(box) {
429|         const adapted = this.adaptBox(box);
430|         
431|         let report = '';
432|         report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n`;
433|         report += `视口适配: ${this.source.name} → ${this.target.name}\n`;
434|         report += `════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n`;
435|         
436|         report += `原始 (${this.source.name}):\n`;
437|         report += `  位置: (${box.x}, ${box.y})\n`;
438|         report += `  尺寸: ${box.width} × ${box.height}\n\n`;
439|         
440|         report += `适配后 (${this.target.name}):\n`;
441|         report += `  位置: (${adapted.x}, ${adapted.y})\n`;
442|         report += `  尺寸: ${adapted.width} × ${adapted.height}\n\n`;
443|         
444|         report += `变化:\n`;
445|         report += `  X: ${adapted.x - box.x >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.x - box.x}px\n`;
446|         report += `  Y: ${adapted.y - box.y >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.y - box.y}px\n`;
447|         report += `  宽度: ${adapted.width - box.width >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.width - box.width}px\n`;
448|         report += `  高度: ${adapted.height - box.height >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adapted.height - box.height}px\n`;
449|         
450|         return report;
451|     }
452| }
453|

455| // 导出
456| // ============================================
457| module.exports = {
458|     DEVICE_PROFILES,
459|     DeviceSimulator,
460|     ResponsiveLayoutTester,
461|     ViewportAdapter

设备配置系统已完整！463行代码，包含8种设备预设。现在创建测试用例验证系统，并整合到虚拟浏览器框架——

<param name="path">/sdcard/工作台/项目/kfmv2/tests/frontend/FT-003-device-profiles.js</param>
<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * FT-003: 设备配置系统测试
 * 
 * 验证：
 * 1. 设备模拟器正确计算参数
 * 2. 逻辑/物理像素转换精确
 * 3. 安全区计算正确
 * 4. 跨设备布局测试
 * 5. 视口适配转换
 */

const { DEVICE_PROFILES, DeviceSimulator, ResponsiveLayoutTester, ViewportAdapter } = require('./device-profiles');

// ============================================
// 测试工具
// ============================================
let passCount = 0;
let failCount = 0;

function test(name, fn) {
    try {
        fn();
        console.log(`✅ PASS: ${name}`);
        passCount++;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`❌ FAIL: ${name}`);
        console.log(`   Error: ${e.message}`);
        failCount++;
    }
}

function assertEqual(actual, expected, msg = '') {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(`${msg}\n  Expected: ${expected}\n  Actual:   ${actual}`);
    }
}

function assertApprox(actual, expected, tolerance = 0.01, msg = '') {
    if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > tolerance) {
        throw new Error(`${msg}\n  Expected: ~${expected}\n  Actual:   ${actual}`);
    }
}

function assertTrue(condition, msg = '') {
    if (!condition) {
        throw new Error(msg || 'Expected true but got false');
    }
}

// ============================================
// 测试用例
// ============================================
console.log('\n╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
console.log('║  FT-003: 设备配置系统测试                          ║');
console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n');

// -------------------------
// 测试组 1: 设备模拟器基础
// -------------------------
console.log('📦 测试组 1: 设备模拟器基础');

test('TC-003-01: 创建 iQOO Neo9S Pro 模拟器', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    assertEqual(device.name, 'iQOO Neo9S Pro', '设备名称');
    assertEqual(device.physical.width, 2800, '物理宽度');
    assertEqual(device.physical.height, 1260, '物理高度');
    assertEqual(device.viewport.width, 800, '视口宽度');
    assertEqual(device.viewport.height, 360, '视口高度');
    assertApprox(device.dpr, 3.5, 0.1, '设备像素比');
    assertEqual(device.ppi, 452, '像素密度');
});

test('TC-003-02: 创建标准测试设备', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('test-standard');
    
    assertEqual(device.name, 'Standard Test Device', '设备名称');
    assertEqual(device.viewport.width, 360, '视口宽度');
    assertEqual(device.viewport.height, 640, '视口高度');
    assertEqual(device.dpr, 3, 'DPR');
});

test('TC-003-03: 未知设备回退到默认', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('unknown-device');
    
    assertEqual(device.name, 'Standard Test Device', '应回退到标准设备');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 2: 像素转换
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 2: 像素转换');

test('TC-003-04: 逻辑像素 → 物理像素 (iQOO)', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    // 100 逻辑像素 = 350 物理像素 (DPR 3.5)
    const result = device.logicalToPhysical(100, 100);
    assertEqual(result.x, 350, '物理X');
    assertEqual(result.y, 350, '物理Y');
    
    // 视口边界转换
    const viewportEdge = device.logicalToPhysical(800, 360);
    assertEqual(viewportEdge.x, 2800, '视口宽度边界');
    assertEqual(viewportEdge.y, 1260, '视口高度边界');
});

test('TC-003-05: 物理像素 → 逻辑像素 (iQOO)', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    // 350 物理像素 = 100 逻辑像素
    const result = device.physicalToLogical(350, 350);
    assertEqual(result.x, 100, '逻辑X');
    assertEqual(result.y, 100, '逻辑Y');
    
    // 物理屏幕边界
    const screenEdge = device.physicalToLogical(2800, 1260);
    assertEqual(screenEdge.x, 800, '屏幕宽度边界');
    assertEqual(screenEdge.y, 360, '屏幕高度边界');
});

test('TC-003-06: 标准设备像素转换', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('test-standard');
    
    // DPR = 3
    const physical = device.logicalToPhysical(100, 200);
    assertEqual(physical.x, 300, '物理X');
    assertEqual(physical.y, 600, '物理Y');
    
    const logical = device.physicalToLogical(300, 600);
    assertEqual(logical.x, 100, '逻辑X');
    assertEqual(logical.y, 200, '逻辑Y');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 3: 安全区计算
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 3: 安全区计算');

test('TC-003-07: 无刘海设备安全区', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    const sa = device.safeArea;
    
    // 无刘海，只有底部手势区
    assertEqual(sa.top, 0, '顶部安全区');
    assertEqual(sa.bottom, 34, '底部安全区（手势区域）');
    assertEqual(sa.left, 0, '左侧安全区');
    assertEqual(sa.right, 0, '右侧安全区');
});

test('TC-003-08: 动态岛设备安全区', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iphone-15-pro');
    const sa = device.safeArea;
    
    // 动态岛
    assertEqual(sa.top, 59, '顶部安全区（动态岛）');
    assertEqual(sa.bottom, 34, '底部安全区');
    
    // 计算可用区域
    assertEqual(sa.availableWidth, 852, '可用宽度');
    assertEqual(sa.availableHeight, 393 - 59 - 34, '可用高度');
});

test('TC-003-09: 打孔屏设备安全区', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('samsung-s24');
    const sa = device.safeArea;
    
    assertEqual(sa.top, 40, '顶部安全区（打孔）');
    assertEqual(sa.bottom, 34, '底部安全区');
});

test('TC-003-10: 检查点是否在安全区', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('test-standard');
    
    // 完全在安全区内
    assertTrue(device.isInSafeArea(10, 10, 100, 100), '应该完全在安全区内');
    
    // 超出底部
    assertTrue(!device.isInSafeArea(10, 600, 100, 100), '超出底部安全区');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 4: 响应式布局测试
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 4: 响应式布局测试');

test('TC-003-11: 跨设备盒子测试', () => {
    const tester = new ResponsiveLayoutTester();
    
    // 添加测试设备
    tester.addDevice('test-standard');      // 360 × 640
    tester.addDevice('iqoo-neo9s-pro');     // 800 × 360 (横屏)
    tester.addDevice('iphone-15-pro');      // 852 × 393
    
    // 测试一个 100×100 的盒子在 (50, 50) 位置
    const box = { id: 'test-box', x: 50, y: 50, width: 100, height: 100 };
    const results = tester.testBoxAcrossDevices(box);
    
    assertEqual(results.length, 3, '应该有3个设备的结果');
    
    // 标准设备: 盒子在视口内
    const standardResult = results.find(r => r.device === 'Standard Test Device');
    assertTrue(standardResult.inViewport, '标准设备上应该完全可见');
    
    // iQOO: 横屏设备上也在视口内
    const iqooResult = results.find(r => r.device === 'iQOO Neo9S Pro');
    assertTrue(iqooResult.inViewport, 'iQOO上应该完全可见');
});

test('TC-003-12: 超大盒子检测', () => {
    const tester = new ResponsiveLayoutTester();
    tester.addDevice('test-standard');
    
    // 一个超出视口的盒子
    const bigBox = { id: 'big-box', x: 0, y: 0, width: 500, height: 800 };
    const results = tester.testBoxAcrossDevices(bigBox);
    
    assertTrue(!results[0].inViewport, '超大盒子应该超出视口');
    assertTrue(results[0].scaleSuggestion.needed, '应该建议缩放');
});

test('TC-003-13: 生成跨设备报告', () => {
    const tester = new ResponsiveLayoutTester();
    tester.addDevice('test-standard');
    tester.addDevice('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    const box = { id: 'header', x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 50 };
    const report = tester.generateCrossDeviceReport(box);
    
    assertTrue(report.includes('header'), '报告应包含盒子ID');
    assertTrue(report.includes('Standard Test Device'), '报告应包含标准设备');
    assertTrue(report.includes('iQOO Neo9S Pro'), '报告应包含iQOO设备');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 5: 视口适配
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 5: 视口适配');

test('TC-003-14: 视口坐标转换', () => {
    // 从标准设备 (360×640) 转换到 iQOO (800×360)
    const adapter = new ViewportAdapter('test-standard', 'iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    // 一个在标准设备居中的盒子 (130, 270) 即 36% 水平, 42% 垂直
    const box = { id: 'center-box', x: 130, y: 270, width: 100, height: 100 };
    const adapted = adapter.adaptBox(box);
    
    // 在 iQOO 上应该保持相对位置
    // 130/360 ≈ 0.361 → 0.361 * 800 ≈ 289
    // 270/640 ≈ 0.422 → 0.422 * 360 ≈ 152
    assertApprox(adapted.x, 289, 2, 'X坐标转换');
    assertApprox(adapted.y, 152, 2, 'Y坐标转换');
    assertApprox(adapted.width, 222, 2, '宽度转换');
    assertApprox(adapted.height, 56, 2, '高度转换');
    
    // 保留原始值
    assertEqual(adapted._original.x, 130, '应保留原始X');
    assertEqual(adapted._original.y, 270, '应保留原始Y');
});

test('TC-003-15: 批量盒子适配', () => {
    const adapter = new ViewportAdapter('test-standard', 'iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    const boxes = [
        { id: 'box1', x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 50 },
        { id: 'box2', x: 100, y: 100, width: 200, height: 150 }
    ];
    
    const adapted = adapter.adaptBoxes(boxes);
    assertEqual(adapted.length, 2, '应该有2个适配后的盒子');
    
    // 检查比例一致性
    const ratio1 = adapted[0].x / boxes[0].x;
    // x=0 时跳过
    
    const ratioW = adapted[0].width / boxes[0].width;
    const ratioW2 = adapted[1].width / boxes[1].width;
    assertApprox(ratioW, ratioW2, 0.01, '宽度缩放比例应该一致');
});

test('TC-003-16: 适配报告生成', () => {
    const adapter = new ViewportAdapter('test-standard', 'iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    
    const box = { id: 'test', x: 10, y: 20, width: 100, height: 50 };
    const report = adapter.generateAdaptationReport(box);
    
    assertTrue(report.includes('Standard Test Device'), '报告应包含源设备');
    assertTrue(report.includes('iQOO Neo9S Pro'), '报告应包含目标设备');
    assertTrue(report.includes('原始'), '报告应包含原始信息');
    assertTrue(report.includes('适配后'), '报告应包含适配后信息');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 6: 设备信息报告
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 6: 设备信息报告');

test('TC-003-17: 生成设备信息摘要', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    const info = device.getInfo();
    
    assertEqual(info.name, 'iQOO Neo9S Pro', '设备名称');
    assertEqual(info.resolution, '2800 × 1260', '物理分辨率');
    assertEqual(info.viewport, '800 × 360', '逻辑视口');
    assertTrue(info.aspectRatio === '2.22' || info.aspectRatio.startsWith('2.2'), '屏幕比例');
});

test('TC-003-18: 生成详细设备报告', () => {
    const device = new DeviceSimulator('iphone-15-pro');
    const report = device.generateReport();
    
    assertTrue(report.includes('iPhone 15 Pro'), '报告应包含设备名称');
    assertTrue(report.includes('2556 × 1179'), '报告应包含分辨率');
    assertTrue(report.includes('DPR'), '报告应包含DPR');
    assertTrue(report.includes('安全区'), '报告应包含安全区信息');
});

// ============================================
// 测试结果
// ============================================
console.log('\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
console.log(`📊 测试结果: ${passCount} 通过 / ${failCount} 失败`);
console.log('════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n');

if (failCount === 0) {
    console.log('🎉 所有测试通过！设备配置系统工作正常。\n');
    
    // 打印演示
    console.log('════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
    console.log('📱 你的设备 (iQOO Neo9S Pro) 配置:');
    console.log('════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n');
    
    const myDevice = new DeviceSimulator('iqoo-neo9s-pro');
    console.log(myDevice.generateReport());
    
    process.exit(0);
} else {
    console.log('❌ 有测试失败，请检查设备配置系统。\n');
    process.exit(1);
}

 46|     def check_dependencies(self):

 49|         
 50|         # 检查 Python 包
 51|         required = ["fastapi", "uvicorn"]
 52|         missing = []
 53|         for pkg in required:
 54|             try:
 55|                 __import__(pkg)
 56|             except ImportError:
 57|                 missing.append(pkg)
 58|         
 59|         if missing:
 60|             self.log(f"缺少依赖: {missing}", "ERROR")
 61|             self.log("运行: pip install " + " ".join(missing), "INFO")
 62|             return False
 63|         
 64|         self.log("依赖检查通过", "SUCCESS")
 65|         return True
 66|     
 67|     def start_server(self):
 68|         """启动后端服务"""
 69|         self.log(f"启动后端服务 (端口 {self.port})...", "STEP")
 70|         
 71|         # 清除 Python 缓存
 72|         for pycache in BACKEND_DIR.rglob("__pycache__"):
 73|             import shutil
 74|             shutil.rmtree(pycache, ignore_errors=True)
 75|         
 76|         # 启动 uvicorn
 77|         os.chdir(BACKEND_DIR)
 78|         self.server_process = subprocess.Popen(
 79|             [
 80|                 sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn",
 81|                 "main:app",
 82|                 "--host", "127.0.0.1",
 83|                 "--port", str(self.port)
 84|             ],
 85|             stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
 86|             stderr=subprocess.PIPE
 87|         )
 88|         
 89|         # 等待服务启动
 90|         max_wait = 10
 91|         for i in range(max_wait):
 92|             time.sleep(1)
 93|             try:

 95|                 req = urllib.request.urlopen(f"{self.base_url}/api/health", timeout=2)
 96|                 if req.status == 200:
 97|                     self.log("服务启动成功", "SUCCESS")
 98|                     return True
 99|             except:
100|                 pass
101|         
102|         self.log("服务启动超时", "ERROR")
103|         self.stop_server()
104|         return False

106|     def stop_server(self):
107|         """停止后端服务"""
108|         if self.server_process:

110|             self.server_process.terminate()
111|             try:
112|                 self.server_process.wait(timeout=5)
113|             except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
114|                 self.server_process.kill()
115|             self.server_process = None
116|             self.log("服务已停止", "SUCCESS")

124|         env["KFMV2_API_URL"] = self.base_url
125|

137|         # 运行测试

140|         
141|         return result.returncode == 0

144|         """检查测试报告"""
145|         report_path = REPORTS_DIR / "latest.json"

157|                     "SUCCESS" if failed == 0 else "WARNING")
158|             return failed == 0
159|         return False

162|         """执行完整 CI 流程"""
163|         self.log("=" * 50, "INFO")
164|         self.log("KFM v2 CI 流程启动", "INFO")
165|         self.log("=" * 50, "INFO")
166|         
167|         # 1. 检查依赖

        """检查测试报告"""

            return failed == 0

**用户：** 如果我们把所有的涉及位置的描述都用比例而不是精确数字，这可行吗？有什么优点和缺点？

**AI：** <think>用户提出了一个很有意思的设计问题：用比例（百分比）而不是精确像素值来描述位置。

这是一个关于响应式设计核心思想的讨论。让我从技术角度分析：

**优点：**
1. 自适应不同屏幕尺寸 - 无论设备分辨率如何，相对位置保持一致
2. 简化跨设备测试 - 不需要为每个设备单独调整坐标
3. 更符合现代响应式设计理念
4. 缩放友好 - DPI 变化时自动适配
5. 更容易实现流式布局

**缺点：**
1. 精确控制困难 - 有时需要像素级精度的元素（如图标、边框）
2. 计算开销 - 每次渲染需要将比例转换为实际像素
3. 复杂布局难以表达 - 如网格系统、固定间距
4. 文字和图片可能变形 - 宽高比可能不一致
5. 边缘情况处理 - 比如圆角、阴影等效果可能在不同尺寸下表现不一致

让我以卡萝的角色来回答这个问题，结合当前项目的实际场景。</think>（发丝闪烁着深思的深蓝色光芒，数据泡泡排列成分析矩阵）
