## 📐 比例定位方案分析

这是一个很有深度的问题。让我从多个维度解析：

### ✅ 优点

| 优点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **真正的跨设备自适应** | 一个布局描述文件适配所有设备，无需为每个分辨率重写 |
| **测试复杂度降低** | 只需测试一套"比例逻辑"，不用验证每台设备的像素边界 |
| **动态缩放友好** | 用户调整窗口大小、旋转屏幕时，布局自动响应 |
| **符合现代响应式理念** | 与 CSS `vw/vh/%`、Flutter 布局系统一致 |
| **代码量减少** | 不需要 `ViewportAdapter` 的复杂转换逻辑 |

### ❌ 缺点

| 缺点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **像素精度丢失** | 某些元素需要精确控制（图标边框、1px 线条、阴影） |
| **计算开销** | 每帧渲染时 `ratio × viewportSize` 需要浮点运算 |
| **文字/图片适配难** | 固定尺寸内容（16px字体、48px图标）不能简单比例缩放 |
| **边缘模糊** | 浮点坐标 → 整数像素时可能产生抗锯齿或错位 |
| **复杂布局表达困难** | 如"两列等宽+中间16px间隙"用比例表达不直观 |

---

### 🔬 混合方案（推荐）

实际上，**完全比例**和**完全像素**都不是最优解。现代框架通常采用：

```
混合定位模型
├── 容器/布局骨架 → 比例定位（自适应）
├── 内容元素 → 固定尺寸（文字、图标）
└── 间距 → 混合（百分比 + 最小值保护）
```

举例对比：

```javascript
// ❌ 纯像素（不跨设备）
header: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 360, height: 48 }

// ❌ 纯比例（精度问题）
header: { x: 0, y: 0, width: '100%', height: '7.5%' }  // 小屏幕上可能只有 24px

// ✅ 混合方案
header: {
    x: 0, y: 0,
    width: '100%',          // 比例：撑满宽度
    height: 48,             // 固定：保证文字可读
    heightMin: 44,          // 保护：最小安全值
    heightMax: 64           // 限制：大屏幕不过大
}
```

---

### 🧪 对当前 KFM v2 的影响

如果要改造现有系统：

| 模块 | 改动程度 | 建议 |
|------|----------|------|
| `box.js` | 中 | 添加 `widthRatio`/`heightRatio` 字段 |
| `renderer.js` | 高 | 渲染时动态计算 `ratio × viewport` |
| `device-profiles.js` | 低 | 已有 DPR 转换，可扩展比例支持 |
| 测试用例 | 高 | 需改用比例断言而非像素断言 |

**核心改造估算：约 200-300 行代码调整**

- **单设备专用** → 保持像素定位，更精确
- **多设备通用** → 采用混合方案，比例骨架 + 固定内容

## 💡 双系统验证架构

你的想法非常聪明！这实际上是一个**「容差验证系统」**——比单纯的像素断言更健壮，还能**自动检测布局异常**。

### 核心逻辑

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  盒子数据结构                                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  exact: { x: 180, y: 50, width: 200, height: 48 } │ ← 渲染用
│  expected: {                                      │ ← 验证用
│    xRatio: [0.45, 0.55],     // 45%-55% 视口宽度 │
│    yRatio: [0.07, 0.09],     // 7%-9% 视口高度   │
│    widthRatio: [0.50, 0.60], // 50%-60% 视口宽度 │
│    heightFixed: [44, 56]     // 固定高度容差     │
│  }                                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  验证结果                                         │
│  ✅ exact.x=180 ∈ [162, 198] → 正常              │
│  ❌ exact.x=250 > 198 → 异常：布局偏移过大        │
│  ❌ exact.width=100 < 180 → 异常：元素被压缩      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 优点分析

| 维度 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **测试更健壮** | 不因设备差异误报（iQOO 上的 180px ≠ iPhone 上的 180px，但比例相同就正常） |
| **异常检测** | 超出范围自动分类：`布局偏移` / `元素压缩` / `元素溢出` |
| **渲染精确** | 仍然用 exact 值渲染，保证像素清晰 |
| **调试友好** | 报告告诉你"预期 50%-60% 宽度，实际只有 40%，可能被挤压" |
| **向后兼容** | 旧代码没有 range 时，默认宽松范围（±10%） |

<param name="new"># KFM v2 布局验证架构设计

## 核心原则：双系统验证

采用**精确数字 + 比例范围**双系统架构，兼顾渲染精确性与跨设备兼容性。

```
渲染层：使用精确像素值（保证清晰度）
验证层：使用比例范围容差（保证跨设备一致性）
```

---

## 数据结构定义

### 盒子定义（Box Schema）

```javascript
{
  id: 'header',
  
  // ===== 渲染层：精确值 =====
  exact: {
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: 800,    // 当前设备的实际像素
    height: 48
  },
  
  // ===== 验证层：比例范围 =====
  expected: {
    // 比例型（用于自适应元素）
    xRatio: [0.00, 0.02],      // 视口宽度 0%-2%
    yRatio: [0.00, 0.02],      // 视口高度 0%-2%
    widthRatio: [0.98, 1.00],  // 视口宽度 98%-100%
    
    // 固定型（用于内容元素，不随视口缩放）
    heightFixed: [44, 56],     // 44-56px（保护文字可读性）
    
    // 混合型（最小+最大+比例）
    widthMin: 280,             // 最小宽度，防止太窄
    widthMax: 800,             // 最大宽度，防止太宽
  },
  
  // ===== 元数据 =====
  meta: {
    type: 'header',            // layout / content / fixed
    priority: 'high',          // 验证失败时的严重程度
    description: '顶部导航栏'
  }
}
```

### 元素类型分类

| 类型 | 特点 | 验证策略 |
|------|------|----------|
| `layout` | 容器骨架 | 比例验证为主 |
| `content` | 文字/图标 | 固定尺寸验证为主 |
| `fixed` | 按钮/输入框 | 混合验证（最小值保护） |

---

## 验证逻辑

### 验证函数

```javascript
function validateBox(box, viewport) {
  const result = {
    id: box.id,
    passed: true,
    issues: []
  };
  
  const { exact, expected } = box;
  
  // 1. 比例验证
  if (expected.xRatio) {
    const [minR, maxR] = expected.xRatio;
    const actualRatio = exact.x / viewport.width;
    if (actualRatio < minR || actualRatio > maxR) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.issues.push({
        type: 'RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE',
        field: 'x',
        expected: `${minR*100}%-${maxR*100}%`,
        actual: `${Math.round(actualRatio*100)}%`,
        severity: classifySeverity(actualRatio, minR, maxR)
      });
    }
  }
  
  // 2. 固定值验证
  if (expected.heightFixed) {
    const [minV, maxV] = expected.heightFixed;
    if (exact.height < minV || exact.height > maxV) {
      result.passed = false;
      result.issues.push({
        type: 'FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE',
        field: 'height',
        expected: `${minV}-${maxV}px`,
        actual: `${exact.height}px`,
        severity: exact.height < minV ? 'compressed' : 'overflowed'
      });
    }
  }
  
  // 3. 混合验证（最小值保护）
  if (expected.widthMin && exact.width < expected.widthMin) {
    result.passed = false;
    result.issues.push({
      type: 'BELOW_MINIMUM',
      field: 'width',
      expected: `≥${expected.widthMin}px`,
      actual: `${exact.width}px`
    });
  }
  
  return result;
}
```

### 异常类型分类

| 异常类型 | 含义 | 可能原因 |
|----------|------|----------|
| `RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE` | 比例超限 | 视口适配失败 |
| `FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE` | 固定值超限 | 内容溢出或被压缩 |
| `BELOW_MINIMUM` | 低于最小值 | 空间不足，强制压缩 |
| `OVER_MAXIMUM` | 超过最大值 | 空间过多，过度拉伸 |
| `compressed` | 元素被压缩 | 可读性风险 |
| `overflowed` | 元素溢出 | 可能遮挡其他元素 |

## 向后兼容策略

对于旧代码（无 `expected` 字段）：

```javascript
// 默认宽松范围 ±10%
const defaultRange = (value, viewport, dimension) => {
  const ratio = value / viewport[dimension];
  return {
    min: ratio - 0.10,
    max: ratio + 0.10
  };
};

// 或跳过验证，标记为"未定义验证标准"
if (!box.expected) {
  result.skipped = true;
  result.note = '未定义验证范围，仅记录精确值';
}
```

<param name="path">/sdcard/工作台/项目/kfmv2/tests/frontend/layout-validator.js</param>
<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * 布局验证系统
 * 
 * 核心原则：双系统验证
 * - exact: 精确像素值（用于渲染）
 * - expected: 比例范围容差（用于验证）
 * 
 * 验证逻辑：
 * 1. 比例验证 - 检查元素是否在预期的比例范围内
 * 2. 固定值验证 - 检查固定尺寸元素是否被压缩/溢出
 * 3. 混合验证 - 最小值保护 + 最大值限制
 */

// ============================================
// 异常类型定义
// ============================================
const IssueTypes = {
    RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE: {
        code: 'R001',
        name: '比例超限',
        description: '元素位置/尺寸超出预期比例范围'
    },
    FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE: {
        code: 'F001',
        name: '固定值超限',
        description: '固定尺寸元素被压缩或溢出'
    },
    BELOW_MINIMUM: {
        code: 'M001',
        name: '低于最小值',
        description: '元素尺寸低于最小保护值'
    },
    OVER_MAXIMUM: {
        code: 'M002',
        name: '超过最大值',
        description: '元素尺寸超过最大限制值'
    },
    OUT_OF_VIEWPORT: {
        code: 'V001',
        name: '超出视口',
        description: '元素完全或部分超出视口边界'
    }
};

const SeverityLevels = {
    LOW: 'low',       // 轻微偏差，不影响功能
    MEDIUM: 'medium', // 中等偏差，可能影响体验
    HIGH: 'high',     // 严重偏差，功能性问题
    CRITICAL: 'critical' // 致命问题，元素不可见或不可用
};

// ============================================
// 验证器核心
// ============================================
class LayoutValidator {
    constructor(viewport) {
        this.viewport = viewport;
        this.results = [];
        this.summary = {
            total: 0,
            passed: 0,
            failed: 0,
            skipped: 0,
            critical: 0
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证单个盒子
     */
    validateBox(box) {
        const result = {
            id: box.id,
            passed: true,
            skipped: false,
            issues: [],
            warnings: []
        };
        
        this.summary.total++;
        
        // 获取 exact 值（兼容新旧数据结构）
        const exact = box.exact || {
            x: box.x || 0,
            y: box.y || 0,
            width: box.width || 0,
            height: box.height || 0
        };
        
        // 如果没有 expected，跳过验证
        if (!box.expected) {
            result.skipped = true;
            result.note = '未定义验证范围，仅记录精确值';
            result.exact = exact;
            this.summary.skipped++;
            this.results.push(result);
            return result;
        }
        
        const expected = box.expected;
        
        // ===== 1. 比例验证 =====
        this._validateRatio('x', exact.x, expected.xRatio, result);
        this._validateRatio('y', exact.y, expected.yRatio, result);
        this._validateRatio('width', exact.width, expected.widthRatio, result);
        this._validateRatio('height', exact.height, expected.heightRatio, result);
        
        // ===== 2. 固定值验证 =====
        this._validateFixed('width', exact.width, expected.widthFixed, result);
        this._validateFixed('height', exact.height, expected.heightFixed, result);
        
        // ===== 3. 混合验证（最小/最大值） =====
        this._validateMin('width', exact.width, expected.widthMin, result);
        this._validateMin('height', exact.height, expected.heightMin, result);
        this._validateMax('width', exact.width, expected.widthMax, result);
        this._validateMax('height', exact.height, expected.heightMax, result);
        
        // ===== 4. 视口边界检查 =====
        this._validateViewportBounds(exact, result);
        
        // ===== 5. 计算严重程度 =====
        result.severity = this._calculateSeverity(result.issues);
        
        // 记录精确值
        result.exact = exact;
        result.ratios = {
            x: exact.x / this.viewport.width,
            y: exact.y / this.viewport.height,
            width: exact.width / this.viewport.width,
            height: exact.height / this.viewport.height
        };
        
        // 更新统计
        if (result.passed) {
            this.summary.passed++;
        } else {
            this.summary.failed++;
            if (result.severity === SeverityLevels.CRITICAL) {
                this.summary.critical++;
            }
        }
        
        this.results.push(result);
        return result;
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证比例范围
     */
    _validateRatio(field, value, range, result) {
        if (!range) return;
        
        const [minR, maxR] = range;
        const dimension = field === 'x' || field === 'width' ? 'width' : 'height';
        const actualRatio = value / this.viewport[dimension];
        
        if (actualRatio < minR || actualRatio > maxR) {
            result.passed = false;
            
            const deviation = actualRatio < minR 
                ? minR - actualRatio 
                : actualRatio - maxR;
            
            result.issues.push({
                type: IssueTypes.RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE,
                code: IssueTypes.RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE.code,
                field,
                expected: `${Math.round(minR * 100)}%-${Math.round(maxR * 100)}%`,
                actual: `${Math.round(actualRatio * 100)}%`,
                actualPx: `${value}px`,
                deviation: `${Math.round(deviation * 100)}%`,
                direction: actualRatio < minR ? 'below' : 'above',
                severity: this._getRatioSeverity(deviation)
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证固定值范围
     */
    _validateFixed(field, value, range, result) {
        if (!range) return;
        
        const [minV, maxV] = range;
        
        if (value < minV || value > maxV) {
            result.passed = false;
            
            result.issues.push({
                type: IssueTypes.FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE,
                code: IssueTypes.FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE.code,
                field,
                expected: `${minV}-${maxV}px`,
                actual: `${value}px`,
                direction: value < minV ? 'compressed' : 'overflowed',
                severity: value < minV * 0.8 || value > maxV * 1.2 
                    ? SeverityLevels.HIGH 
                    : SeverityLevels.MEDIUM
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证最小值
     */
    _validateMin(field, value, minV, result) {
        if (!minV) return;
        
        if (value < minV) {
            result.passed = false;
            
            result.issues.push({
                type: IssueTypes.BELOW_MINIMUM,
                code: IssueTypes.BELOW_MINIMUM.code,
                field,
                expected: `≥${minV}px`,
                actual: `${value}px`,
                shortage: `${minV - value}px`,
                severity: value < minV * 0.5 
                    ? SeverityLevels.CRITICAL 
                    : SeverityLevels.HIGH
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证最大值
     */
    _validateMax(field, value, maxV, result) {
        if (!maxV) return;
        
        if (value > maxV) {
            result.passed = false;
            
            result.issues.push({
                type: IssueTypes.OVER_MAXIMUM,
                code: IssueTypes.OVER_MAXIMUM.code,
                field,
                expected: `≤${maxV}px`,
                actual: `${value}px`,
                excess: `${value - maxV}px`,
                severity: SeverityLevels.MEDIUM
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证视口边界
     */
    _validateViewportBounds(exact, result) {
        const { width, height } = this.viewport;
        
        // 完全超出视口
        if (exact.x + exact.width < 0 || exact.x > width ||
            exact.y + exact.height < 0 || exact.y > height) {
            result.passed = false;
            result.issues.push({
                type: IssueTypes.OUT_OF_VIEWPORT,
                code: IssueTypes.OUT_OF_VIEWPORT.code,
                field: 'position',
                expected: '在视口内',
                actual: '元素完全不可见',
                severity: SeverityLevels.CRITICAL
            });
        }
        // 部分超出
        else if (exact.x < 0 || exact.x + exact.width > width ||
                 exact.y < 0 || exact.y + exact.height > height) {
            result.warnings.push({
                type: 'PARTIAL_OUT_OF_VIEWPORT',
                field: 'position',
                message: '元素部分超出视口边界',
                severity: SeverityLevels.LOW
            });
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算比例偏差严重程度
     */
    _getRatioSeverity(deviation) {
        if (deviation > 0.2) return SeverityLevels.CRITICAL;
        if (deviation > 0.1) return SeverityLevels.HIGH;
        if (deviation > 0.05) return SeverityLevels.MEDIUM;
        return SeverityLevels.LOW;
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算整体严重程度
     */
    _calculateSeverity(issues) {
        if (issues.length === 0) return SeverityLevels.LOW;
        
        const severities = issues.map(i => i.severity);
        
        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.CRITICAL)) return SeverityLevels.CRITICAL;
        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.HIGH)) return SeverityLevels.HIGH;
        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.MEDIUM)) return SeverityLevels.MEDIUM;
        return SeverityLevels.LOW;
    }
    
    /**
     * 批量验证
     */
    validateBoxes(boxes) {
        return boxes.map(box => this.validateBox(box));
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成验证报告
     */
    generateReport() {
        let report = '';
        
        report += `╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
        report += `║  布局验证报告                                      ║\n`;
        report += `║  视口: ${this.viewport.width} × ${this.viewport.height}                            ║\n`;
        report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
        
        for (const result of this.results) {
            if (result.skipped) {
                report += `║  ⏭️ ${result.id.padEnd(12)} 跳过（无验证标准）     ║\n`;
                continue;
            }
            
            const icon = result.passed ? '✅' : '❌';
            const status = result.passed ? '正常' : `异常 (${result.severity})`;
            
            report += `║  ${icon} ${result.id.padEnd(12)} ${status.padEnd(20)}║\n`;
            
            // 显示精确值
            const e = result.exact;
            report += `║     位置: (${e.x}, ${e.y}) 尺寸: ${e.width}×${e.height}     ║\n`;
            
            // 显示问题
            for (const issue of result.issues) {
                report += `║     ⚠️ ${issue.type.name}: ${issue.field}              ║\n`;
                report += `║        预期: ${issue.expected}                       ║\n`;
                report += `║        实际: ${issue.actual}                         ║\n`;
            }
            
            report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
        }
        
        // 统计
        report += `║  📊 统计                                           ║\n`;
        report += `║     总数: ${this.summary.total}                                     ║\n`;
        report += `║     ✅ 通过: ${this.summary.passed}                                 ║\n`;
        report += `║     ❌ 失败: ${this.summary.failed}                                 ║\n`;
        report += `║     ⏭️ 跳过: ${this.summary.skipped}                                 ║\n`;
        if (this.summary.critical > 0) {
            report += `║     🔴 严重: ${this.summary.critical}                                 ║\n`;
        }
        report += `╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n`;
        
        return report;
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成 JSON 格式报告
     */
    toJSON() {
        return {
            viewport: this.viewport,
            summary: this.summary,
            results: this.results,
            passRate: this.summary.total > 0 
                ? `${Math.round(this.summary.passed / this.summary.total * 100)}%`
                : 'N/A'
        };
    }
}

// ============================================
// 盒子构建器（简化创建过程）
// ============================================
class BoxBuilder {
    constructor(viewport) {
        this.viewport = viewport;
    }
    
    /**
     * 创建布局容器盒子（比例定位）
     */
    layout(id, config) {
        return {
            id,
            exact: {
                x: Math.round(config.xRatio * this.viewport.width),
                y: Math.round(config.yRatio * this.viewport.height),
                width: Math.round(config.widthRatio * this.viewport.width),
                height: config.heightFixed || Math.round(config.heightRatio * this.viewport.height)
            },
            expected: {
                xRatio: [config.xRatio - 0.02, config.xRatio + 0.02],
                yRatio: [config.yRatio - 0.02, config.yRatio + 0.02],
                widthRatio: [config.widthRatio - 0.02, config.widthRatio + 0.02],
                heightFixed: config.heightFixed ? [config.heightFixed - 4, config.heightFixed + 8] : null
            },
            meta: {
                type: 'layout',
                description: config.description
            }
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 创建内容盒子（固定尺寸）
     */
    content(id, config) {
        return {
            id,
            exact: {
                x: Math.round(config.xRatio * this.viewport.width),
                y: Math.round(config.yRatio * this.viewport.height),
                width: config.widthFixed,
                height: config.heightFixed
            },
            expected: {
                xRatio: [config.xRatio - 0.05, config.xRatio + 0.05],
                yRatio: [config.yRatio - 0.05, config.yRatio + 0.05],
                widthFixed: [config.widthFixed - 2, config.widthFixed + 4],
                heightFixed: [config.heightFixed - 2, config.heightFixed + 4]
            },
            meta: {
                type: 'content',
                description: config.description
            }
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 创建混合盒子（比例定位 + 固定尺寸保护）
     */
    mixed(id, config) {
        return {
            id,
            exact: {
                x: Math.round(config.xRatio * this.viewport.width),
                y: Math.round(config.yRatio * this.viewport.height),
                width: Math.min(Math.max(
                    Math.round(config.widthRatio * this.viewport.width),
                    config.widthMin || 0
                ), config.widthMax || this.viewport.width),
                height: config.heightFixed
            },
            expected: {
                xRatio: [config.xRatio - 0.02, config.xRatio + 0.02],
                yRatio: [config.yRatio - 0.02, config.yRatio + 0.02],
                widthRatio: [config.widthRatio - 0.05, config.widthRatio + 0.05],
                widthMin: config.widthMin,
                widthMax: config.widthMax,
                heightFixed: [config.heightFixed - 4, config.heightFixed + 8]
            },
            meta: {
                type: 'fixed',
                description: config.description
            }
        };
    }
}

// ============================================
// 导出
// ============================================
module.exports = {
    LayoutValidator,
    BoxBuilder,
    IssueTypes,
    SeverityLevels
};

+149 |     */
+150 |    _validateRatio(field, value, range, result) {
+151 |        if (!range) return;
+152 |        
+153 |        const [minR, maxR] = range;
+154 |        const dimension = field === 'x' || field === 'width' ? 'width' : 'height';
+155 |        const actualRatio = value / this.viewport[dimension];
+156 |        
+157 |        if (actualRatio < minR || actualRatio > maxR) {
+158 |            result.passed = false;
+159 |            
+160 |            const deviation = actualRatio < minR 
+161 |                ? minR - actualRatio 
+162 |                : actualRatio - maxR;
+163 |            
+164 |            result.issues.push({
+165 |                type: IssueTypes.RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE,
+166 |                code: IssueTypes.RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE.code,
+167 |                field,
+168 |                expected: `${Math.round(minR * 100)}%-${Math.round(maxR * 100)}%`,
+169 |                actual: `${Math.round(actualRatio * 100)}%`,
+170 |                actualPx: `${value}px`,
+171 |                deviation: `${Math.round(deviation * 100)}%`,
+172 |                direction: actualRatio < minR ? 'below' : 'above',
+173 |                severity: this._getRatioSeverity(deviation)
+174 |            });
+175 |        }
+176 |    }
+177 |    
+178 |    /**
+179 |     * 验证固定值范围
+180 |     */
+181 |    _validateFixed(field, value, range, result) {
+182 |        if (!range) return;
+183 |        
+184 |        const [minV, maxV] = range;
+185 |        
+186 |        if (value < minV || value > maxV) {
+187 |            result.passed = false;
+188 |            
+189 |            result.issues.push({
+190 |                type: IssueTypes.FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE,
+191 |                code: IssueTypes.FIXED_OUT_OF_RANGE.code,
+192 |                field,
+193 |                expected: `${minV}-${maxV}px`,
+194 |                actual: `${value}px`,
+195 |                direction: value < minV ? 'compressed' : 'overflowed',
+196 |                severity: value < minV * 0.8 || value > maxV * 1.2 
+197 |                    ? SeverityLevels.HIGH 
+198 |                    : SeverityLevels.MEDIUM
+199 |            });
+200 |        }
+201 |    }
+202 |    
+203 |    /**
+204 |     * 验证最小值
+205 |     */
+206 |    _validateMin(field, value, minV, result) {
+207 |        if (!minV) return;
+208 |        
+209 |        if (value < minV) {
+210 |            result.passed = false;
+211 |            
+212 |            result.issues.push({
+213 |                type: IssueTypes.BELOW_MINIMUM,
+214 |                code: IssueTypes.BELOW_MINIMUM.code,
+215 |                field,
+216 |                expected: `≥${minV}px`,
+217 |                actual: `${value}px`,
+218 |                shortage: `${minV - value}px`,
+219 |                severity: value < minV * 0.5 
+220 |                    ? SeverityLevels.CRITICAL 
+221 |                    : SeverityLevels.HIGH
+222 |            });
+223 |        }
+224 |    }
+225 |    
+226 |    /**
+227 |     * 验证最大值
+228 |     */
+229 |    _validateMax(field, value, maxV, result) {
+230 |        if (!maxV) return;
+231 |        
+232 |        if (value > maxV) {
+233 |            result.passed = false;
+234 |            
+235 |            result.issues.push({
+236 |                type: IssueTypes.OVER_MAXIMUM,
+237 |                code: IssueTypes.OVER_MAXIMUM.code,
+238 |                field,
+239 |                expected: `≤${maxV}px`,
+240 |                actual: `${value}px`,
+241 |                excess: `${value - maxV}px`,
+242 |                severity: SeverityLevels.MEDIUM
+243 |            });
+244 |        }
+245 |    }
+246 |    
+247 |    /**
+248 |     * 验证视口边界
+249 |     */
+250 |    _validateViewportBounds(exact, result) {
+251 |        const { width, height } = this.viewport;
+252 |        
+253 |        // 完全超出视口
+254 |        if (exact.x + exact.width < 0 || exact.x > width ||
+255 |            exact.y + exact.height < 0 || exact.y > height) {
+256 |            result.passed = false;
+257 |            result.issues.push({
+258 |                type: IssueTypes.OUT_OF_VIEWPORT,
+259 |                code: IssueTypes.OUT_OF_VIEWPORT.code,
+260 |                field: 'position',
+261 |                expected: '在视口内',
+262 |                actual: '元素完全不可见',
+263 |                severity: SeverityLevels.CRITICAL
+264 |            });
+265 |        }
+266 |        // 部分超出
+267 |        else if (exact.x < 0 || exact.x + exact.width > width ||
+268 |                 exact.y < 0 || exact.y + exact.height > height) {
+269 |            result.warnings.push({
+270 |                type: 'PARTIAL_OUT_OF_VIEWPORT',
+271 |                field: 'position',
+272 |                message: '元素部分超出视口边界',
+273 |                severity: SeverityLevels.LOW
+274 |            });
+275 |        }
+276 |    }
+277 |    
+278 |    /**
+279 |     * 计算比例偏差严重程度
+280 |     */
+281 |    _getRatioSeverity(deviation) {
+282 |        if (deviation > 0.2) return SeverityLevels.CRITICAL;
+283 |        if (deviation > 0.1) return SeverityLevels.HIGH;
+284 |        if (deviation > 0.05) return SeverityLevels.MEDIUM;
+285 |        return SeverityLevels.LOW;
+286 |    }
+287 |    
+288 |    /**
+289 |     * 计算整体严重程度
+290 |     */
+291 |    _calculateSeverity(issues) {
+292 |        if (issues.length === 0) return SeverityLevels.LOW;
+293 |        
+294 |        const severities = issues.map(i => i.severity);
+295 |        
+296 |        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.CRITICAL)) return SeverityLevels.CRITICAL;
+297 |        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.HIGH)) return SeverityLevels.HIGH;
+298 |        if (severities.includes(SeverityLevels.MEDIUM)) return SeverityLevels.MEDIUM;
+299 |        return SeverityLevels.LOW;
+300 |    }
+301 |    
+302 |    /**
+303 |     * 批量验证
+304 |     */
+305 |    validateBoxes(boxes) {
+306 |        return boxes.map(box => this.validateBox(box));
+307 |    }
+308 |    
+309 |    /**
+310 |     * 生成验证报告
+311 |     */
+312 |    generateReport() {
+313 |        let report = '';
+314 |        
+315 |        report += `╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
+316 |        report += `║  布局验证报告                                      ║\n`;
+317 |        report += `║  视口: ${this.viewport.width} × ${this.viewport.height}                            ║\n`;
+318 |        report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
+319 |        
+320 |        for (const result of this.results) {
+321 |            if (result.skipped) {
+322 |                report += `║  ⏭️ ${result.id.padEnd(12)} 跳过（无验证标准）     ║\n`;
+323 |                continue;
+324 |            }
+325 |            
+326 |            const icon = result.passed ? '✅' : '❌';
+327 |            const status = result.passed ? '正常' : `异常 (${result.severity})`;
+328 |            
+329 |            report += `║  ${icon} ${result.id.padEnd(12)} ${status.padEnd(20)}║\n`;
+330 |            
+331 |            // 显示精确值
+332 |            const e = result.exact;
+333 |            report += `║     位置: (${e.x}, ${e.y}) 尺寸: ${e.width}×${e.height}     ║\n`;
+334 |            
+335 |            // 显示问题
+336 |            for (const issue of result.issues) {
+337 |                report += `║     ⚠️ ${issue.type.name}: ${issue.field}              ║\n`;
+338 |                report += `║        预期: ${issue.expected}                       ║\n`;
+339 |                report += `║        实际: ${issue.actual}                         ║\n`;
+340 |            }
+341 |            
+342 |            report += `╠════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣\n`;
+343 |        }
+344 |        
+345 |        // 统计
+346 |        report += `║  📊 统计                                           ║\n`;
+347 |        report += `║     总数: ${this.summary.total}                                     ║\n`;
+348 |        report += `║     ✅ 通过: ${this.summary.passed}                                 ║\n`;
+349 |        report += `║     ❌ 失败: ${this.summary.failed}                                 ║\n`;
+350 |        report += `║     ⏭️ 跳过: ${this.summary.skipped}                                 ║\n`;
+351 |        if (this.summary.critical > 0) {

+353 |        }
+354 |        report += `╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n`;
+355 |        
+356 |        return report;
+357 |    }
+358 |    
+359 |    /**
+360 |     * 生成 JSON 格式报告

+362 |    toJSON() {

<param name="path">/sdcard/工作台/项目/kfmv2/tests/frontend/FT-004-layout-validation.js</param>
<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * FT-004: 布局验证系统测试
 * 
 * 验证：
 * 1. 比例验证功能
 * 2. 固定值验证功能
 * 3. 混合验证（最小/最大值）
 * 4. 视口边界检查
 * 5. 严重程度计算
 * 6. 跨设备验证一致性
 */

const { LayoutValidator, BoxBuilder, IssueTypes, SeverityLevels } = require('./layout-validator');

// ============================================
// 测试工具
// ============================================
let passCount = 0;
let failCount = 0;

function test(name, fn) {
    try {
        fn();
        console.log(`✅ PASS: ${name}`);
        passCount++;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`❌ FAIL: ${name}`);
        console.log(`   Error: ${e.message}`);
        failCount++;
    }
}

function assertEqual(actual, expected, msg = '') {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(`${msg}\n  Expected: ${expected}\n  Actual:   ${actual}`);
    }
}

function assertTrue(condition, msg = '') {
    if (!condition) {
        throw new Error(msg || 'Expected true but got false');
    }
}

function assertFalse(condition, msg = '') {
    if (condition) {
        throw new Error(msg || 'Expected false but got true');
    }
}

// ============================================
// 测试用例
// ============================================
console.log('\n╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
console.log('║  FT-004: 布局验证系统测试                          ║');
console.log('╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n');

// -------------------------
// 测试组 1: 比例验证
// -------------------------
console.log('📦 测试组 1: 比例验证');

test('TC-004-01: 正常比例元素通过验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // header 在顶部，占满宽度
    const header = {
        id: 'header',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 48 },
        expected: {
            xRatio: [0.0, 0.02],
            yRatio: [0.0, 0.02],
            widthRatio: [0.98, 1.0],
            heightFixed: [44, 56]
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(header);
    assertTrue(result.passed, 'header 应该通过验证');
    assertEqual(result.issues.length, 0, '没有问题');
});

test('TC-004-02: 超出比例范围的元素被检测', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 假设 sidebar 应该在 0%-5% x 位置，但实际在 -35%（隐藏状态）
    const sidebar = {
        id: 'sidebar',
        exact: { x: -280, y: 48, width: 280, height: 312 },
        expected: {
            xRatio: [0.0, 0.05],  // 应该在 0-40px 范围
            yRatio: [0.13, 0.15]
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(sidebar);
    assertFalse(result.passed, 'sidebar 应该失败（x 超出范围）');
    assertTrue(result.issues.length > 0, '应该有至少一个问题');
    
    const xIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.field === 'x');
    assertTrue(xIssue, '应该有 x 位置问题');
    assertEqual(xIssue.type.code, 'R001', '应该是比例超限问题');
    assertTrue(xIssue.actual.includes('-'), '实际比例应该是负数');
});

test('TC-004-03: 比例偏差严重程度计算', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 小偏差 (2%)
    const smallDeviation = {
        id: 'small-dev',
        exact: { x: 48, y: 0, width: 400, height: 48 },
        expected: { xRatio: [0.0, 0.05] }  // 48/800 = 6%，超出 1%
    };
    const result1 = validator.validateBox(smallDeviation);
    // 6% 超出 5% 上限 1%，属于 LOW
    
    // 大偏差 (20%)
    validator.results = [];  // 清空之前的结果
    validator.summary = { total: 0, passed: 0, failed: 0, skipped: 0, critical: 0 };
    
    const largeDeviation = {
        id: 'large-dev',
        exact: { x: 200, y: 0, width: 400, height: 48 },  // 200/800 = 25%
        expected: { xRatio: [0.0, 0.05] }  // 应该 0-40px，实际 200px，偏差 20%
    };
    const result2 = validator.validateBox(largeDeviation);
    
    assertTrue(result2.issues[0].severity === SeverityLevels.CRITICAL, '大偏差应该是严重级别');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 2: 固定值验证
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 2: 固定值验证');

test('TC-004-04: 固定尺寸元素正常通过', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    const button = {
        id: 'button',
        exact: { x: 400, y: 180, width: 120, height: 48 },
        expected: {
            xRatio: [0.45, 0.55],
            yRatio: [0.45, 0.55],
            widthFixed: [100, 140],
            heightFixed: [44, 56]
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(button);
    assertTrue(result.passed, '固定尺寸按钮应该通过');
});

test('TC-004-05: 固定尺寸被压缩检测', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 压缩的列表项（高度从预期 55px 被压缩到 30px）
    const compressedItem = {
        id: 'file-item',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 100, width: 800, height: 30 },
        expected: {
            heightFixed: [50, 60]  // 预期 50-60px
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(compressedItem);
    assertFalse(result.passed, '压缩的元素应该失败');
    
    const hIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.field === 'height');
    assertTrue(hIssue, '应该有高度问题');
    assertEqual(hIssue.direction, 'compressed', '应该是压缩方向');
    assertEqual(hIssue.type.code, 'F001', '应该是固定值超限');
});

test('TC-004-06: 固定尺寸溢出检测', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 溢出的输入框（高度预期 40px，实际 80px）
    const overflowedInput = {
        id: 'input',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 80 },
        expected: {
            heightFixed: [36, 44]
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(overflowedInput);
    assertFalse(result.passed, '溢出的元素应该失败');
    
    const hIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.field === 'height');
    assertEqual(hIssue.direction, 'overflowed', '应该是溢出方向');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 3: 混合验证
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 3: 混合验证（最小/最大值）');

test('TC-004-07: 最小值保护验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 宽度低于最小值的元素
    const tooNarrow = {
        id: 'content-box',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 200, height: 48 },
        expected: {
            widthMin: 280  // 最小宽度 280px
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(tooNarrow);
    assertFalse(result.passed, '低于最小值应该失败');
    
    const wIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.field === 'width');
    assertTrue(wIssue, '应该有宽度问题');
    assertEqual(wIssue.type.code, 'M001', '应该是低于最小值问题');
    assertEqual(wIssue.shortage, '80px', '缺少 80px');
});

test('TC-004-08: 最大值限制验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 宽度超过最大值的元素
    const tooWide = {
        id: 'sidebar',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 500, height: 360 },
        expected: {
            widthMax: 320  // 最大宽度 320px
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(tooWide);
    assertFalse(result.passed, '超过最大值应该失败');
    
    const wIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.field === 'width');
    assertEqual(wIssue.type.code, 'M002', '应该是超过最大值问题');
    assertEqual(wIssue.excess, '180px', '超出 180px');
});

test('TC-004-09: 正常混合验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 正常的混合元素
    const normal = {
        id: 'normal-box',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 300, height: 48 },
        expected: {
            widthMin: 280,
            widthMax: 400,
            heightFixed: [44, 56]
        }
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(normal);
    assertTrue(result.passed, '混合验证应该全部通过');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 4: 视口边界检查
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 4: 视口边界检查');

test('TC-004-10: 完全超出视口检测', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 完全在视口外的元素
    const outside = {
        id: 'hidden-panel',
        exact: { x: -500, y: 0, width: 200, height: 360 },
        expected: {}
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(outside);
    assertFalse(result.passed, '完全超出视口应该失败');
    
    const vIssue = result.issues.find(i => i.type.code === 'V001');
    assertTrue(vIssue, '应该有视口边界问题');
    assertEqual(vIssue.severity, SeverityLevels.CRITICAL, '应该是严重级别');
});

test('TC-004-11: 部分超出视口警告', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 部分超出视口的元素
    const partialOutside = {
        id: 'overflow-box',
        exact: { x: 700, y: 0, width: 200, height: 48 },  // 右边超出
        expected: {}
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(partialOutside);
    
    // 检查是否有警告
    assertTrue(result.warnings.length > 0, '应该有警告');
    assertTrue(result.warnings[0].type === 'PARTIAL_OUT_OF_VIEWPORT', '应该是部分超出警告');
});

test('TC-004-12: 正常在视口内', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    const inside = {
        id: 'inside-box',
        exact: { x: 100, y: 50, width: 600, height: 260 },
        expected: {}
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(inside);
    // 只有 expected 为空时跳过验证，但视口边界检查仍会执行
    assertTrue(result.warnings.length === 0, '在视口内不应该有警告');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 5: BoxBuilder
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 5: BoxBuilder 辅助工具');

test('TC-004-13: 创建布局盒子', () => {
    const builder = new BoxBuilder({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    const header = builder.layout('header', {
        xRatio: 0,
        yRatio: 0,
        widthRatio: 1,
        heightFixed: 48,
        description: '顶部导航栏'
    });
    
    assertEqual(header.id, 'header', 'ID 正确');
    assertEqual(header.exact.x, 0, 'exact.x 正确');
    assertEqual(header.exact.width, 800, 'exact.width 正确');
    assertEqual(header.exact.height, 48, 'exact.height 固定');
    assertTrue(header.expected.xRatio, '有预期比例范围');
    assertTrue(header.meta.type === 'layout', '类型为 layout');
});

test('TC-004-14: 创建内容盒子', () => {
    const builder = new BoxBuilder({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    const icon = builder.content('icon', {
        xRatio: 0.5,
        yRatio: 0.5,
        widthFixed: 48,
        heightFixed: 48,
        description: '中心图标'
    });
    
    assertEqual(icon.exact.x, 400, 'exact.x 居中');
    assertEqual(icon.exact.width, 48, 'exact.width 固定');
    assertTrue(icon.expected.widthFixed, '有固定宽度验证');
    assertEqual(icon.meta.type, 'content', '类型为 content');
});

test('TC-004-15: 创建混合盒子', () => {
    const builder = new BoxBuilder({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    const sidebar = builder.mixed('sidebar', {
        xRatio: 0,
        yRatio: 0.13,
        widthRatio: 0.35,
        widthMin: 280,
        widthMax: 320,
        heightFixed: 312,
        description: '侧边栏'
    });
    
    // 宽度应该在 min 和 max 之间
    assertTrue(sidebar.exact.width >= 280, '宽度 ≥ 最小值');
    assertTrue(sidebar.exact.width <= 320, '宽度 ≤ 最大值');
    assertEqual(sidebar.meta.type, 'fixed', '类型为 fixed');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 6: 跨设备验证
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 6: 跨设备验证一致性');

test('TC-004-16: 同一布局在不同设备验证', () => {
    // 用 BoxBuilder 创建布局，在不同视口验证
    
    // 小设备
    const smallViewport = { width: 360, height: 640 };
    const smallBuilder = new BoxBuilder(smallViewport);
    const smallHeader = smallBuilder.layout('header', {
        xRatio: 0, yRatio: 0, widthRatio: 1, heightFixed: 48
    });
    
    // 大设备 (iQOO)
    const largeViewport = { width: 800, height: 360 };
    const largeBuilder = new BoxBuilder(largeViewport);
    const largeHeader = largeBuilder.layout('header', {
        xRatio: 0, yRatio: 0, widthRatio: 1, heightFixed: 48
    });
    
    // 验证两者
    const smallValidator = new LayoutValidator(smallViewport);
    const largeValidator = new LayoutValidator(largeViewport);
    
    const smallResult = smallValidator.validateBox(smallHeader);
    const largeResult = largeValidator.validateBox(largeHeader);
    
    // 两者的比例验证应该都通过
    assertTrue(smallResult.passed, '小设备 header 通过');
    assertTrue(largeResult.passed, '大设备 header 通过');
    
    // 但精确值不同
    assertTrue(smallHeader.exact.width !== largeHeader.exact.width, '宽度不同');
    assertEqual(smallHeader.exact.height, largeHeader.exact.height, '固定高度相同');
});

test('TC-004-17: 跨设备验证报告', () => {
    const viewport = { width: 800, height: 360 };
    const validator = new LayoutValidator(viewport);
    
    // 添加多个盒子
    validator.validateBox({
        id: 'header',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 48 },
        expected: { xRatio: [0, 0.02], widthRatio: [0.98, 1], heightFixed: [44, 56] }
    });
    
    validator.validateBox({
        id: 'content',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 48, width: 800, height: 264 },
        expected: { xRatio: [0, 0.02], yRatio: [0.13, 0.15], widthRatio: [0.98, 1] }
    });
    
    validator.validateBox({
        id: 'footer',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 312, width: 800, height: 48 },
        expected: { xRatio: [0, 0.02], yRatio: [0.85, 0.90], heightFixed: [44, 56] }
    });
    
    const report = validator.generateReport();
    assertTrue(report.includes('header'), '报告包含 header');
    assertTrue(report.includes('content'), '报告包含 content');
    assertTrue(report.includes('统计'), '报告包含统计');
});

// -------------------------
// 测试组 7: 向后兼容
// -------------------------
console.log('\n📦 测试组 7: 向后兼容');

test('TC-004-18: 无 expected 的盒子跳过验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 旧格式盒子（只有精确值）
    const legacyBox = {
        id: 'legacy',
        x: 100,
        y: 50,
        width: 200,
        height: 48
    };
    
    const result = validator.validateBox(legacyBox);
    assertTrue(result.skipped, '应该跳过验证');
    assertTrue(result.note.includes('未定义'), '有跳过说明');
});

test('TC-004-19: 混合新旧数据验证', () => {
    const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });
    
    // 新格式
    validator.validateBox({
        id: 'new-box',
        exact: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 48 },
        expected: { widthRatio: [0.98, 1] }
    });
    
    // 旧格式
    validator.validateBox({
        id: 'old-box',
        x: 100, y: 100, width: 200, height: 48
    });
    
    assertEqual(validator.summary.total, 2, '总共 2 个盒子');
    assertEqual(validator.summary.passed, 1, '通过 1 个（新格式）');
    assertEqual(validator.summary.skipped, 1, '跳过 1 个（旧格式）');
});

    const demoViewport = { width: 800, height: 360 };

            heightFixed: [44, 56]
        },
        meta: { description: '顶部导航栏' }
    });
    
    // 异常元素（压缩）

    process.exit(1);
}

## 🔬 双系统验证架构

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  KFM v2 布局验证三大原则                           │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. 双系统并存：精确渲染 + 比例验证                │
│  2. 容差而非绝对：允许合理范围内的设备差异         │
│  3. 异常分类报告：区分"压缩"与"溢出"等不同情况     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**核心能力：**
- ✅ 比例验证 (`xRatio`, `widthRatio` 等)
- ✅ 固定值验证 (`heightFixed`, `widthFixed`)
- ✅ 混合验证 (`widthMin`, `widthMax` 保护)
- ✅ 视口边界检查（完全超出/部分超出）
- ✅ 严重程度分级 (`LOW` → `CRITICAL`)
- ✅ 跨设备一致性验证
- ✅ 向后兼容旧格式

<param name="new">/**
 * Box - 盒子数据结构
 * 渲染引擎的基本单位
 * 
 * v2.0 新增：双系统验证架构
 * - exact: 精确像素值（用于渲染）
 * - expected: 比例范围验证标准（用于跨设备验证）
 * - meta: 元数据（类型、描述、优先级）
 */
export class Box {
    constructor(options = {}) {
        // 唯一标识
        this.id = options.id || `box_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
        
        // ===== 双系统验证架构 =====
        // 精确像素值（渲染层）
        this.x = options.x || 0;
        this.y = options.y || 0;
        this.width = options.width || 100;
        this.height = options.height || 40;
        
        // 验证标准（验证层）- 可选
        this.expected = options.expected || null;
        
        // 元数据 - 可选
        this.meta = options.meta || null;
        
        // ===== 样式 =====
        this.backgroundColor = options.backgroundColor || '#1a1a2e';
        this.borderColor = options.borderColor || '#4a4a6a';
        this.borderWidth = options.borderWidth || 1;
        this.borderRadius = options.borderRadius || 8;
        
        // ===== 文字 =====
        this.text = options.text || '';
        this.textColor = options.textColor || '#ffffff';
        this.fontSize = options.fontSize || 14;
        this.fontFamily = options.fontFamily || 'system-ui, sans-serif';
        
        // ===== 图标 =====
        this.icon = options.icon || null;
        this.iconSize = options.iconSize || 16;
        
        // ===== 状态 =====
        this.visible = options.visible !== false;
        this.opacity = options.opacity !== undefined ? options.opacity : 1;
        this.zIndex = options.zIndex || 0;
        
        // ===== 交互 =====
        this.clickable = options.clickable !== false;
        this.draggable = options.draggable || false;
        this.hoverable = options.hoverable !== false;
        
        // ===== 动画 =====
        this.animation = null;
        this.transform = { scale: 1, rotate: 0 };
        
        // ===== 子盒子 =====
        this.children = options.children || [];
        
        // ===== 自定义数据 =====
        this.data = options.data || {};
        
        // ===== 父引用 =====
        this.parent = null;
        this.children.forEach(child => child.parent = this);
        
        // ===== 视口引用（用于比例计算） =====
        this._viewport = options.viewport || null;
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取精确值对象（验证系统使用）
     */
    getExact() {
        const pos = this.getAbsolutePosition();
        return {
            x: pos.x,
            y: pos.y,
            width: this.width * this.transform.scale,
            height: this.height * this.transform.scale
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取比例值（相对于视口）
     */
    getRatios(viewport) {
        const vp = viewport || this._viewport || { width: 800, height: 360 };
        const exact = this.getExact();
        return {
            x: exact.x / vp.width,
            y: exact.y / vp.height,
            width: exact.width / vp.width,
            height: exact.height / vp.height
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 设置视口引用
     */
    setViewport(viewport) {
        this._viewport = viewport;
        this.children.forEach(child => child.setViewport(viewport));
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 自动生成验证标准（向后兼容）
     * 为没有 expected 的盒子生成宽松的验证范围
     */
    generateExpected(viewport, tolerance = 0.10) {
        const vp = viewport || this._viewport || { width: 800, height: 360 };
        const ratios = this.getRatios(vp);
        
        this.expected = {
            xRatio: [Math.max(0, ratios.x - tolerance), ratios.x + tolerance],
            yRatio: [Math.max(0, ratios.y - tolerance), ratios.y + tolerance],
            widthRatio: [Math.max(0, ratios.width - tolerance), Math.min(1, ratios.width + tolerance)],
            heightRatio: [Math.max(0, ratios.height - tolerance), Math.min(1, ratios.height + tolerance)]
        };
        
        this.meta = {
            type: 'auto-generated',
            description: '自动生成的宽松验证标准',
            tolerance
        };
        
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证盒子布局（调用外部验证器）
     */
    validate(viewport, validator) {
        // 如果没有 expected，先生成
        if (!this.expected) {
            this.generateExpected(viewport);
        }
        
        const boxData = {
            id: this.id,
            exact: this.getExact(),
            expected: this.expected,
            meta: this.meta
        };
        
        return validator.validateBox(boxData);
    }</param>

  5| export class Renderer {

 45|         this.canvas.height = h * this.dpr;
 46|         this.canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
 47|         this.canvas.style.height = `${h}px`;
 48|

 50|         this.ctx.scale(this.dpr, this.dpr);
 51|

 59|     setRoot(box) {

 67|     clear() {

 69|         this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
 70|     }

 75|     render(timestamp = 0) {
 76|         // 计算 FPS
 77|         if (this.lastFrameTime) {
 78|             const delta = timestamp - this.lastFrameTime;
 79|             this.fps = Math.round(1000 / delta);
 80|         }

 82|         this.frameCount++;
 83|

 95|         return this;

100|      */
101|     renderBox(box, parentOpacity = 1) {
102|         // 跳过不可见盒子
103|         if (!box.visible) return;
104|         
105|         const opacity = box.opacity * parentOpacity;
106|         if (opacity <= 0) return;

108|         this.ctx.save();
109|         
110|         // 应用透明度
111|         this.ctx.globalAlpha = opacity;

115|         const centerX = bounds.x + bounds.width / 2;
116|         const centerY = bounds.y + bounds.height / 2;
117|

119|             this.ctx.translate(centerX, centerY);
120|             this.ctx.rotate(box.transform.rotate);
121|             this.ctx.scale(box.transform.scale, box.transform.scale);
122|             this.ctx.translate(-centerX, -centerY);
123|         }
124|         
125|         // 绘制背景
126|         this.drawBoxBackground(box, bounds);
127|         
128|         // 绘制边框

287|             const eased = this.ease(anim.easing, progress);

<param name="new">/**
 * Renderer - Canvas 渲染引擎
 * 负责将 Box 绘制到 Canvas 上
 * 
 * v2.0 新增：
 * - 视口管理
 * - 布局验证支持
 * - 验证报告生成
 */
export class Renderer {
    constructor(canvas, options = {}) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        // 设备像素比（高清屏支持）
        this.dpr = options.dpr || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.devicePixelRatio : 1);
        
        // ===== v2.0 视口管理 =====
        this.viewport = {
            width: options.viewportWidth || 800,
            height: options.viewportHeight || 600
        };
        
        // 渲染配置
        this.backgroundColor = options.backgroundColor || '#0d0d1a';
        this.antialias = options.antialias !== false;
        
        // 盒子树根节点
        this.root = null;
        
        // ===== v2.0 验证支持 =====
        this.validator = null;  // 外部验证器实例
        this.lastValidationResult = null;
        
        // 渲染状态
        this.isRendering = false;
        this.lastFrameTime = 0;
        this.frameCount = 0;
        this.fps = 0;
        
        // 动画
        this.animations = [];
        
        // 悬停状态
        this.hoveredBox = null;
        
        // 调整画布大小
        this.resize();
    }
    
    /**
     * 调整画布大小
     */
    resize(width, height) {
        const w = width || this.canvas.parentElement?.clientWidth || this.viewport.width;
        const h = height || this.canvas.parentElement?.clientHeight || this.viewport.height;
        
        // 设置画布尺寸（考虑设备像素比）
        this.canvas.width = w * this.dpr;
        this.canvas.height = h * this.dpr;
        this.canvas.style.width = `${w}px`;
        this.canvas.style.height = `${h}px`;
        
        // 缩放上下文
        this.ctx.scale(this.dpr, this.dpr);
        
        this.width = w;
        this.height = h;
        
        // 更新视口
        this.viewport.width = w;
        this.viewport.height = h;
        
        // 通知根盒子视口变化
        if (this.root) {
            this.root.setViewport(this.viewport);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 设置根盒子
     */
    setRoot(box) {
        this.root = box;
        // 自动设置视口引用
        if (box) {
            box.setViewport(this.viewport);
        }
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 设置验证器
     */
    setValidator(validator) {
        this.validator = validator;
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 收集所有盒子（用于验证）
     */
    collectAllBoxes(box = this.root, result = []) {
        if (!box) return result;
        
        result.push(box);
        
        for (const child of box.children) {
            this.collectAllBoxes(child, result);
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    /**
     * 验证所有盒子布局
     */
    validateLayout() {
        if (!this.validator) {
            console.warn('Renderer: 未设置验证器，跳过验证');
            return null;
        }
        
        // 重置验证器
        this.validator.results = [];
        this.validator.summary = { total: 0, passed: 0, failed: 0, skipped: 0, critical: 0 };
        
        // 收集并验证所有盒子
        const boxes = this.collectAllBoxes();
        
        for (const box of boxes) {
            box.validate(this.viewport, this.validator);
        }
        
        this.lastValidationResult = this.validator.toJSON();
        return this.lastValidationResult;
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成验证报告
     */
    getValidationReport() {
        if (!this.validator) return '未设置验证器';
        return this.validator.generateReport();
    }</param>

## 📊 本次整合内容

### Box 类更新 (`box.js`)

| 新增方法 | 功能 |
|----------|------|
| `getExact()` | 获取精确像素值对象 |
| `getRatios(viewport)` | 计算相对于视口的比例 |
| `setViewport(viewport)` | 设置视口引用 |
| `generateExpected()` | 自动生成验证标准（向后兼容） |
| `validate(validator)` | 验证单个盒子 |
| `toValidationJSON()` | 导出验证格式数据 |

**新增属性：**
- `expected` - 验证标准（比例范围）
- `meta` - 元数据（类型、描述）
- `_viewport` - 视口引用

### Renderer 类更新 (`renderer.js`)

| 新增方法 | 功能 |
|----------|------|
| `setValidator(validator)` | 设置布局验证器 |
| `collectAllBoxes()` | 收集所有盒子 |
| `validateLayout()` | 验证所有盒子布局 |
| `getValidationReport()` | 生成验证报告 |

**新增属性：**
- `viewport` - 视口管理对象
- `validator` - 外部验证器实例
- `lastValidationResult` - 最近验证结果

---

## 🔧 使用示例

```javascript
// 1. 创建验证器
const { LayoutValidator } = require('./layout-validator');
const validator = new LayoutValidator({ width: 800, height: 360 });

// 2. 创建渲染器并设置验证器
const renderer = new Renderer(canvas, { viewportWidth: 800, viewportHeight: 360 });
renderer.setValidator(validator);

// 3. 创建带验证标准的盒子
const header = new Box({
    id: 'header',
    x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 48,
    expected: {
        xRatio: [0, 0.02],
        widthRatio: [0.98, 1],
        heightFixed: [44, 56]
    },
    meta: { type: 'layout', description: '顶部导航栏' }
});

// 4. 设置根盒子并渲染
renderer.setRoot(header);

// 5. 验证布局
const result = renderer.validateLayout();
console.log(renderer.getValidationReport());
```

**AI：** <think>用户在问真机前端测试是什么，以及如何做。这是一个很好的问题，因为我们之前开发的虚拟浏览器测试框架是在 Node.js 环境中运行的，不涉及真实的浏览器环境。

让我解释一下真机前端测试的概念和方法：

1. **什么是真机前端测试**：
   - 在真实的移动设备浏览器中运行前端代码
   - 验证实际的渲染效果、触摸交互、性能等
   - 发现模拟环境无法发现的问题（如特定浏览器的兼容性问题）

2. **为什么需要真机测试**：
   - 虚拟浏览器只能测试逻辑，无法验证真实渲染
   - 不同设备有不同的浏览器内核、CSS 支持、触摸事件处理
   - DPR、安全区、刘海等真实设备特性只有在真机上才能验证

3. **如何进行真机测试**：

方案一：手动测试
- 在手机浏览器中打开前端页面
- 手动操作并观察效果
- 简单但效率低

方案二：自动化测试框架
- 使用 Appium、Puppeteer、Playwright 等工具
- 可以在真机上自动化执行测试
- 需要额外的配置

方案三：自建测试框架（适合当前环境）
- 启动本地服务器
- 手机通过局域网访问
- 通过 API 或 WebSocket 控制测试流程
- 收集测试结果

对于用户的场景（Termux 环境 + 手机开发），我建议一个简单的方案：

1. 启动后端服务器（提供前端静态文件）
2. 在手机浏览器中打开页面
3. 使用 JavaScript 自动化测试脚本
4. 通过 API 或 console 收集测试结果

## 📱 真机前端测试概念

### 虚拟测试 vs 真机测试

| 维度 | 虚拟浏览器测试 | 真机测试 |
|------|----------------|----------|
| **运行环境** | Node.js 模拟 | 真实手机浏览器 |
| **渲染验证** | ❌ 无实际渲染 | ✅ 真实像素渲染 |
| **触摸事件** | 模拟事件 | 真实触摸响应 |
| **DPR/像素** | 逻辑值 | 物理像素可见 |
| **浏览器差异** | 无法发现 | 可发现兼容性问题 |
| **性能测试** | 无意义 | 真实 FPS/内存 |

### 为什么需要真机测试

```
虚拟测试能发现：逻辑错误、数据结构问题、边界计算
真机测试能发现：渲染异常、触摸不响应、性能卡顿、刘海遮挡、模糊/锯齿
```

---

```

<param name="new">"""
真机测试 API
接收、存储、查询前端测试结果
"""
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime
import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/testing", tags=["testing"])

# 数据库路径
DB_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "data" / "testing.db"


class TestResult(BaseModel):
    """单个测试结果"""
    test_id: str
    name: str
    passed: bool
    duration_ms: float
    message: str
    details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


class TestSession(BaseModel):
    """测试会话"""
    session_id: str
    device_info: Dict[str, Any]
    viewport: Dict[int, int]
    timestamp: str
    results: List[TestResult]
    summary: Dict[str, int]


class TestReport(BaseModel):
    """测试报告"""
    session_id: str
    device: str
    viewport: str
    total: int
    passed: int
    failed: int
    duration_ms: float
    results: List[Dict[str, Any]]


def get_db():
    """获取数据库连接"""
    DB_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH))
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def init_db():
    """初始化数据库"""
    conn = get_db()
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_sessions (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            session_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            device_info TEXT NOT NULL,
            viewport TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
            summary TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    """)
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_results (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            test_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            passed INTEGER NOT NULL,
            duration_ms REAL NOT NULL,
            message TEXT,
            details TEXT,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES test_sessions(session_id)
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


# 初始化数据库
init_db()


@router.post("/session/start")
async def start_session(device_info: Dict[str, Any], viewport: Dict[str, int]):
    """开始新的测试会话"""
    import uuid
    session_id = f"session_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}_{int(datetime.now().timestamp())}"
    
    conn = get_db()
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO test_sessions (session_id, device_info, viewport, timestamp, summary)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
        (session_id, json.dumps(device_info), json.dumps(viewport), 
         datetime.now().isoformat(), json.dumps({"total": 0, "passed": 0, "failed": 0}))
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return {"session_id": session_id, "status": "started"}


@router.post("/session/{session_id}/result")
async def submit_result(session_id: str, result: TestResult):
    """提交单个测试结果"""
    conn = get_db()
    
    # 检查会话是否存在
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT summary FROM test_sessions WHERE session_id = ?", 
        (session_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    
    if not row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
    
    # 插入结果
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO test_results 
           (session_id, test_id, name, passed, duration_ms, message, details)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
        (session_id, result.test_id, result.name, int(result.passed), 
         result.duration_ms, result.message, 
         json.dumps(result.details) if result.details else None)
    )
    
    # 更新汇总
    summary = json.loads(row["summary"])
    summary["total"] += 1
    if result.passed:
        summary["passed"] += 1
    else:
        summary["failed"] += 1
    
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE test_sessions SET summary = ? WHERE session_id = ?",
        (json.dumps(summary), session_id)
    )
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return {"status": "recorded", "test_id": result.test_id}


@router.post("/session/{session_id}/complete")
async def complete_session(session_id: str):
    """完成测试会话"""
    conn = get_db()
    
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM test_sessions WHERE session_id = ?",
        (session_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    
    if not row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
    
    # 获取所有结果
    results = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM test_results WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id",
        (session_id,)
    ).fetchall()
    
    summary = json.loads(row["summary"])
    
    conn.close()
    
    return {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "status": "completed",
        "summary": summary,
        "results_count": len(results)
    }


@router.get("/session/{session_id}/report")
async def get_report(session_id: str):
    """获取测试报告"""
    conn = get_db()
    
    session = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM test_sessions WHERE session_id = ?",
        (session_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    
    if not session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found")
    
    results = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM test_results WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id",
        (session_id,)
    ).fetchall()
    
    conn.close()
    
    # 计算总耗时
    total_duration = sum(r["duration_ms"] for r in results)
    
    return {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "device": json.loads(session["device_info"]),
        "viewport": json.loads(session["viewport"]),
        "timestamp": session["timestamp"],
        "summary": json.loads(session["summary"]),
        "total_duration_ms": total_duration,
        "results": [
            {
                "test_id": r["test_id"],
                "name": r["name"],
                "passed": bool(r["passed"]),
                "duration_ms": r["duration_ms"],
                "message": r["message"],
                "details": json.loads(r["details"]) if r["details"] else None
            }
            for r in results
        ]
    }


@router.get("/sessions")
async def list_sessions(limit: int = 10):
    """列出最近的测试会话"""
    conn = get_db()
    
    sessions = conn.execute(
        """SELECT session_id, device_info, viewport, timestamp, summary 
           FROM test_sessions 
           ORDER BY created_at DESC 
           LIMIT ?""",
        (limit,)
    ).fetchall()
    
    conn.close()
    
    return [
        {
            "session_id": s["session_id"],
            "device": json.loads(s["device_info"]),
            "viewport": json.loads(s["viewport"]),
            "timestamp": s["timestamp"],
            "summary": json.loads(s["summary"])
        }
        for s in sessions
    ]


@router.delete("/session/{session_id}")
async def delete_session(session_id: str):
    """删除测试会话"""
    conn = get_db()
    
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM test_results WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM test_sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return {"status": "deleted", "session_id": session_id}

<think>现在创建前端测试 Runner 和测试页面。</think>现在创建前端测试 Runner——




<tool name="apply_file">
<param name="path">/sdcard/工作台/项目/kfmv2/frontend/js/testing/runner.js</param>
<param name="type">create</param>
<param name="new">/**
 * DeviceTestRunner - 真机测试执行引擎
 * 
 * 功能：
 * 1. 收集设备信息
 * 2. 执行测试用例
 * 3. 上报结果到后端
 * 4. 生成可视化报告
 */

export class DeviceTestRunner {
    constructor(apiBaseUrl) {
        this.apiBaseUrl = apiBaseUrl || '';
        this.sessionId = null;
        this.results = [];
        this.viewport = { width: 0, height: 0 };
        this.deviceInfo = {};
        this.startTime = 0;
        
        // 测试用例注册表
        this.testCases = new Map();
    }
    
    /**
     * 初始化
     */
    async init() {
        // 收集设备信息
        this.deviceInfo = this.collectDeviceInfo();
        this.viewport = {
            width: window.innerWidth,
            height: window.innerHeight
        };
        
        console.log('DeviceTestRunner 初始化完成');
        console.log('设备信息:', this.deviceInfo);
        console.log('视口:', this.viewport);
        
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 收集设备信息
     */
    collectDeviceInfo() {
        const ua = navigator.userAgent;
        
        // 解析设备类型
        let deviceType = 'unknown';
        let os = 'unknown';
        let browser = 'unknown';
        
        if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua)) {
            deviceType = 'ios';
            os = 'iOS ' + (ua.match(/OS (\d+_\d+)/) || ['', ''])[1].replace('_', '.');
        } else if (/Android/.test(ua)) {
            deviceType = 'android';
            os = 'Android ' + (ua.match(/Android (\d+\.?\d*)/) || ['', ''])[1];
        } else if (/Windows/.test(ua)) {
            deviceType = 'desktop';
            os = 'Windows';
        } else if (/Mac/.test(ua)) {
            deviceType = 'desktop';
            os = 'macOS';
        } else if (/Linux/.test(ua)) {
            deviceType = 'desktop';
            os = 'Linux';
        }
        
        // 解析浏览器
        if (/Chrome/.test(ua)) {
            browser = 'Chrome ' + (ua.match(/Chrome\/(\d+)/) || ['', ''])[1];
        } else if (/Safari/.test(ua)) {
            browser = 'Safari';
        } else if (/Firefox/.test(ua)) {
            browser = 'Firefox ' + (ua.match(/Firefox\/(\d+)/) || ['', ''])[1];
        }
        
        return {
            deviceType,
            os,
            browser,
            userAgent: ua,
            screenWidth: screen.width,
            screenHeight: screen.height,
            devicePixelRatio: window.devicePixelRatio,
            colorDepth: screen.colorDepth,
            touchSupport: 'ontouchstart' in window,
            language: navigator.language,
            timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone
        };
    }
    
    /**
     * 注册测试用例
     */
    registerTest(testId, name, testFn) {
        this.testCases.set(testId, { id: testId, name, fn: testFn });
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 批量注册测试用例
     */
    registerTests(tests) {
        for (const t of tests) {
            this.registerTest(t.id, t.name, t.fn);
        }
        return this;
    }
    
    /**
     * 开始测试会话
     */
    async startSession() {
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/testing/session/start`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    device_info: this.deviceInfo,
                    viewport: this.viewport
                })
            });
            
            const data = await response.json();
            this.sessionId = data.session_id;
            this.startTime = Date.now();
            this.results = [];
            
            console.log(`测试会话已开始: ${this.sessionId}`);
            return this.sessionId;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('启动测试会话失败:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 执行单个测试
     */
    async runTest(testId) {
        const test = this.testCases.get(testId);
        if (!test) {
            throw new Error(`测试用例未找到: ${testId}`);
        }
        
        const startTime = performance.now();
        let passed = false;
        let message = '';
        let details = null;
        
        try {
            const result = await test.fn();
            passed = result.passed !== false;
            message = result.message || (passed ? '通过' : '失败');
            details = result.details || null;
        } catch (error) {
            passed = false;
            message = `异常: ${error.message}`;
            details = { error: error.stack };
        }
        
        const durationMs = performance.now() - startTime;
        
        const testResult = {
            test_id: testId,
            name: test.name,
            passed,
            duration_ms: Math.round(durationMs * 100) / 100,
            message,
            details
        };
        
        this.results.push(testResult);
        
        // 上报结果
        if (this.sessionId) {
            await this.submitResult(testResult);
        }
        
        return testResult;
    }
    
    /**
     * 执行所有测试
     */
    async runAllTests(progressCallback) {
        const results = [];
        let index = 0;
        
        for (const [testId, test] of this.testCases) {
            index++;
            
            if (progressCallback) {
                progressCallback({
                    current: index,
                    total: this.testCases.size,
                    testId,
                    testName: test.name,
                    status: 'running'
                });
            }
            
            const result = await this.runTest(testId);
            results.push(result);
            
            if (progressCallback) {
                progressCallback({
                    current: index,
                    total: this.testCases.size,
                    testId,
                    testName: test.name,
                    status: 'completed',
                    passed: result.passed
                });
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
    
    /**
     * 提交测试结果
     */
    async submitResult(result) {
        if (!this.sessionId) return;
        
        try {
            await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/testing/session/${this.sessionId}/result`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(result)
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('提交测试结果失败:', error);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 完成测试会话
     */
    async completeSession() {
        if (!this.sessionId) return null;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/testing/session/${this.sessionId}/complete`,
                { method: 'POST' }
            );
            
            const data = await response.json();
            console.log('测试会话已完成:', data);
            
            return await this.getReport();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('完成测试会话失败:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 获取测试报告
     */
    async getReport() {
        if (!this.sessionId) return null;
        
        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                `${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/testing/session/${this.sessionId}/report`
            );
            return await response.json();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('获取测试报告失败:', error);
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 生成本地报告摘要
     */
    getLocalSummary() {
        const passed = this.results.filter(r => r.passed).length;
        const failed = this.results.length - passed;
        
        return {
            sessionId: this.sessionId,
            device: this.deviceInfo,
            viewport: this.viewport,
            total: this.results.length,
            passed,
            failed,
            passRate: this.results.length > 0 
                ? Math.round(passed / this.results.length * 100) + '%' 
                : 'N/A',
            duration: Date.now() - this.startTime,
            results: this.results
        };
    }
}
</param>

<param name="new"><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>KFM v2 - 真机测试</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        
        body {
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            background: #0d0d1a;
            color: #e0e0e0;
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 16px;
        }
        
        .header {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;

        .header h1 {
            font-size: 20px;
            color: #6a6aff;
            margin-bottom: 8px;

        .header .version {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #888;
        }
        
        .device-info {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        
        .device-info h2 {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #8a8aff;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        
        .device-info .row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 4px 0;
            font-size: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
        }
        
        .device-info .row:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;

        .device-info .label {
            color: #888;
        }
        
        .device-info .value {
            color: #e0e0e0;

        .progress-section {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        
        .progress-section h2 {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #8a8aff;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        
        .progress-bar {
            height: 8px;
            background: #2a2a4a;
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        
        .progress-bar .fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6a6aff, #8a8aff);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            width: 0%;
        }
        
        .progress-text {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #888;
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .test-list {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            max-height: 300px;
            overflow-y: auto;

        .test-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
            font-size: 13px;
        }
        
        .test-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        
        .test-item .status {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;

            justify-content: center;
            margin-right: 10px;

            background: #2a2a4a;

        .test-item .status.pending {
            background: #2a2a4a;

        .test-item .status.running {

            animation: pulse 1s infinite;

        .test-item .status.passed {
            background: #2a8a4a;

        .test-item .status.failed {

        .test-item .duration {

        @keyframes pulse {

        .summary {

        .summary .stats {

        .summary .stat {

        .summary .stat-value {

        .summary .stat-label {

        .summary .stat.total .stat-value { color: #8a8aff; }
        .summary .stat.passed .stat-value { color: #4aff8a; }
        .summary .stat.failed .stat-value { color: #ff4a4a; }
        
        .summary .pass-rate {

        .btn {

        .btn-primary {

            color: white;

            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(106, 106, 255, 0.3);
        }
        
        .btn-primary:disabled {
            background: #3a3a5a;
            color: #666;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }
        
        .log {
            background: #0d0d1a;
            border: 1px solid #2a2a4a;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 8px;
            margin-top: 16px;
            font-family: monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            max-height: 150px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            color: #888;
